originalJobContent:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.



Our Graduate Programme is built for ambitious graduates ready to kick-start their careers in tech. Over this 12-month programme, you’ll join our engineering teams, tackle real-world projects, and take on challenges that drive impact. With structured training, hands-on experience, and guidance from experts, you’ll grow your skills, explore different areas, and shape the future of finance.

Top performers may be offered a full-time role after the programme, giving you the chance to continue your journey at Revolut.



Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.

We’re looking for problem-solving Frontend Engineers with a passion for web technologies and design who want to bring our products to life and deliver seamless experiences for our customers

Our stack includes React, TypeScript, Redux, Webpack, Jest, Cypress, and a TDD approach.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.



The Graduate Programme is open to international applicants ready to relocate to one of our tech hubs in Poland, Portugal, Spain, the UAE, or the UK. We’ll support you with visa assistance, travel costs, and your first month of accommodation (conditions apply). You’ll be expected to spend around 3 days per week in the office (where role and location allow).





Roles are filled on a rolling basis, so apply early. You can specify your preferred intake during the recruitment process.









Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

originalJobContent:
About the company:

KIEFER is building Greece's integrated AI ecosystem. From renewable energy infrastructure and AI systems to robotics and enterprise applications, we connect the technologies that power Europe's intelligent future. Founded in 2014, KIEFER has delivered 600MW+ of energy projects and is now developing sovereign AI infrastructure, enterprise AI products and physical AI systems for Greece and Southeast Europe.



We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong frontend expertise to take ownership of product surfaces within Sophea Nous, our enterprise AI search and assistant platform.

Sophea Nous connects to the places where a company’s knowledge already lives and allows users to search, receive answers with verified citations, and work with AI assistants and agents. The platform is multi-tenant, self-hosted, and already used by enterprise customers.

You will own features end to end, including the interface, supporting backend, automated tests, release, and production behaviour. You will work closely with a product manager and UI/UX designer from the early stages of product development, helping decide what should be built and how it should work.

This is a large, live codebase that needs to evolve incrementally. The role offers significant technical autonomy and ownership across web, mobile, and desktop. It is not a maintenance role.

TypeScript, React, and Next.js for web, React Native with Expo for mobile, and Electron for desktop. The backend is built with Python, FastAPI, and Celery, using PostgreSQL and Redis. It also includes a retrieval service and an LLM gateway connected to our own GPU infrastructure. Everything runs on Kubernetes.

















Compensation Range: €60K - €90K

title: Frontend Developer (Web & Mobile)
originalJobContent:
We're looking for a Frontend Developer to join our team in Copenhagen - someone equally comfortable shipping on the web and on mobile. This is a genuinely 50/50 role split between our web platform and native app work, not a web role with occasional mobile work.

You'll split your time across our web platform and the Dreaminfluence app - a mobile platform that thousands of influencers use to discover brand campaigns, upload content, track performance, and get paid. Dreaminfluence is the influencer-facing side of a two-sided marketplace: brands run campaigns on our web platform, and influencers find and deliver them through the app.

Dreaminfluence was acquired by Flowbox earlier this year. Flowbox is a SaaS company founded in 2016 that helps brands collect, manage, and distribute user-generated content. Post-acquisition, we serve more than 1,000 customers, report close to €9M in ARR, and employ over 70 people across offices in Stockholm, Barcelona, Amsterdam, and Copenhagen.



Our Tech Department is made up of two core teams:

The Influencer Platform Team (Copenhagen): The team behind the influencer marketing part of the Flowbox platform, developing and maintaining a platform for influencer collaboration, campaign management, and performance tracking. We handle everything from influencer payments and reporting to analytics and insights, making it simple for brands and influencers to connect, collaborate, and generate results.

We work cross-functionally in a hybrid environment, collaborating across disciplines to deliver impactful solutions. In this team, you'll find a balance of challenge, creativity, and ownership, with plenty of opportunities to make a real impact on Flowbox's core product.

We believe in pair programming, regular code reviews, and open feedback, helping each other grow while maintaining high-quality standards across everything we build. AI is part of how we work day to day - we build with Claude Code, not as an experiment on the side, but as a normal part of the toolkit.

The UGC Platform Team (Barcelona): Responsible for the heart of our UGC platform, including integrations, back-office tools, content collection, moderation, and distribution. We also manage event streams, analytics, and data infrastructure, ensuring our systems are efficient, reliable, and scalable.



As our Frontend Developer in Copenhagen, you'll contribute across both our web app and the Dreaminfluence mobile app - building new features, improving existing workflows, and helping raise the bar on user experience across the board.





We're open on seniority - mid-level to senior - as long as you can ship production front-end code with confidence.

title: Senior Front-End (React) Engineer
originalJobContent:
About Nabla

We are a team of entrepreneurs, clinicians and engineers committed to bringing back joy to the practice of medicine.

Together with a community of clinician innovators, we’ve harnessed the best of machine learning science to develop Nabla: the leading AI assistant that’s restoring the human connection at the heart of healthcare. By streamlining clinical documentation, Nabla is helping clinicians focus on what matters most - patient care. Today, over 100,000+ clinicians across 130+ healthcare organizations trust Nabla to support how they deliver care every day.

We’re at the start of an ambitious journey: Ambient listening, dictation, coding, and command capabilities are all converging into a proactive assistant that intuitively streamlines clinical and financial workflows.

Backed by a recent $70M Series C, we’re hiring to build the next generation of clinical AI and improve the lives of clinicians and patients everywhere.

This is a great time to join us!



Nabla’s phenomenal traction is the result of 3 years of diligent product development.

Led by former Meta AI Research engineers, our team has consistently anticipated how AI can revolutionize healthcare delivery. Our Machine Learning team continually leverages the latest advancements to unlock AI’s full potential in healthcare.

Yann LeCun, Meta’s Chief AI Scientist and Turing award winner, is an advisor to Nabla.



Engineering at Nabla is lean, fast-moving, and deeply technical. Our teams span machine learning, native desktop applications, and platform infrastructure to deliver AI into clinical settings reliably and at scale.



At Nabla, product development is led jointly by Engineering and Product, and organized into cross-functional squads, each focused on a specific product area. Squads bring together product managers, designers, engineers of different profiles, and domain experts, and operate with a high level of ownership.

As a Senior FrontEnd Engineer, you’ll join one of these squads and contribute end to end to a specific part of the product.



As a Senior Front-End Engineer, you will lead the development of high-impact user experiences across our web apps, desktop apps, browser extensions, and mobile interfaces. You will set the standard for UI quality and performance, and play a central role in evolving our design system, architecture, and tooling.



















Our offices are based in Paris 3e (Arts & Métiers). Our flexible hybrid policy allows 1-2 remote days per week, plus 1-2 weeks fully remote per year.



Just like we’re dedicated to supporting doctors’ well-being, ensuring yours is a top priority. We firmly believe that by prioritizing your well-being, we support you to excel in your work.







When you become a part of our company, you join a team of excellence-driven, curious, and genuinely kind individuals. Together, we're committed to making clinicians' lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe in a world where clinicians can focus on what they were trained to do - caring for their patients, and where no patient feels their visit was rushed.

We come to work excited to leverage AI to do more for clinicians. We’re obsessed with our users’ satisfaction and we actively seek out opportunities to engage one-on-one with clinicians to understand how Nabla can better help. We consistently look for ways to improve and do not shy away from doing the work to excel. Whether it’s a feature our users asked for, or a new article for our blog, we prioritize collaboration to deliver exceptional outcomes.

We love having fun as much as we love work. Our #nablabla channel is as active as our #feature-show-off channel, we exercise during the work day at least 3 times a week (yoga, running, pilates, or HIIT, your choice!), enjoy regular off-sites to gather the team, and travel to see each other in places like NY, Paris, San Francisco, and many other vibrant cities. Oh, and we’re constantly snacking on chocolate or nuts!

If this sounds like an environment you’ll thrive in, we look forward to reading your application!



Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.



We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.



There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.



We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.



We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.



Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment scam which is now using Nabla to collect personal information or financial scams. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure whomever is contacting you truly represents Nabla and is utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity from people who could be pretending to be recruiters or senior professionals at Nabla. You can find more information following this link.

originalJobContent:
Safran.AI - De l'IA qui opère dans le réel

Filiale de Safran Electronics & Defense, Safran.AI conçoit des solutions d'IA appliquées à des données complexes telles que les images satellite haute résolution, les flux vidéo FMV et les signaux acoustiques. Ces solutions s'appuient sur des algorithmes capables de détecter et d'identifier automatiquement des objets d'intérêt dans les secteurs du renseignement, de la défense et de l'aéronautique.

Depuis son intégration à Safran en septembre 2024, Safran.AI contribue également à la transformation du groupe, en appliquant les solutions d’IA aux domaines de l’industrie 4.0. À titre d’exemple, l’analyse d’images automatisée par l’IA peut assister les contrôleurs en charge de l’inspection de pièces critiques en les aidant à détecter les anomalies éventuelles à partir de clichés numériques.

Fort de nos 250 collaborateurs, vous évoluerez au sein d’équipes passionnées et pluridisciplinaires, réunissant des talents parmi les plus reconnus du secteur, tous animés par une même exigence d’excellence et d’innovation technologique.



Vous rejoindrez une équipe de développement travaillant sur des projets nécessitants des déploiements on-premise et vous serez responsable de la conception et du développement continu de notre produit et de notre infrastructure en utilisant essentiellement Python, PostgreSQL, React, Typescript et d'autres technologies innovantes.

Au-delà de l'exécution, vous serez force de proposition sur les choix d'architecture et les compromis techniques : vous challengez l'existant, proposez des alternatives et documentez vos décisions. Les agents IA (Claude, Copilot ou équivalents) font partie intégrante de notre boîte à outils quotidienne, et nous cherchons quelqu'un qui sait s'en servir avec discernement — pour aller plus vite sans sacrifier la rigueur.



En tant que Senior Front-end Développeur, vous devrez notamment :

→ Concevoir, architecturer et développer nos interfaces utilisateurs de nouvelle génération, en garantissant performance, robustesse et évolutivité

→ Packager et intégrer nos API dans des plateformes web modernes pour étendre notre portée commerciale

→ Faire la différence par une UX de qualité, en améliorant l'efficacité des workflows et en réduisant les coûts opérationnels pour nos utilisateurs

→ Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes back-end et les experts métier pour comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs finaux et concevoir les bonnes solutions techniques

→ Être le référent front au sein de l'équipe : structurer les choix d'architecture front, élever le niveau technique collectif et représenter cette expertise au-delà de l'équipe (veille, retours d'expérience, contributions internes ou externes).

→ Contribuer à promouvoir une culture d'ingénierie forte et une exigence de qualité

Côté stack :

Nos équipes utilisent principalement Typescript (React) pour la partie front-end, qui communique avec un back-end en Python et une base PostgreSQL. Nous utilisons également Docker pour le déploiement, et nos DevOps s'appuient sur Ansible, Terraform et la suite Prometheus/Grafana pour l'automatisation et le monitoring.

Vous évoluerez dans un contexte multi-espaces de travail avec des règles de sécurité associées, ce qui requiert adaptabilité, rigueur et résilience.





→ Vous avez une expérience solide (5-10 ans) sur une stack web moderne, avec une maîtrise impérative de React et Typescript.

→ Vous avez de l'expérience dans le déploiement de systèmes complexes sur des plateformes cloud (AWS, GCP...).

→ Vous concevez des solutions élégantes et pensez en ingénieur : vous évaluez les compromis, anticipez la dette technique et savez dire non à une mauvaise idée.

→ Vous êtes passionné(e) par le développement de code de qualité et les tests automatisés, et savez livrer dans les délais.

→ Vous possédez un excellent sens de l'organisation, êtes autonome et avez la capacité à établir des rapports.

→ Vous êtes à l'aise à l'oral comme à l'écrit en anglais et motivé(e) pour collaborer avec des interlocuteurs internationaux (clients, partenaires, communauté open source).

→ Une expérience avec MapBox, Leaflet ou des produits liés à la géomatique serait un vrai plus, ainsi qu'une connaissance du WebGL.

→ Une capacité fullstack (Python, Node.js...) et une première expérience en responsabilité end-to-end sur un produit seraient des atouts complémentaires.

→ Vous suivez ou contribuez à la communauté front (blogs techniques, conférences, projets open source, veille active) et aimez partager ce que vous apprenez.

→ Une expérience dans des environnements startup ou à haute fiabilité (cloud, défense, aéronautique...) avec une responsabilité directe sur la maintenance et l'amélioration de produits, infrastructures et process serait un très fort atout.





Safran.AI réuni des sujets techniques de fond, des équipes qui maîtrisent leur domaine et une culture où la rigueur et l'entraide coexistent.

Structure à taille humaine adossée à un groupe industriel de premier plan, elle permet de travailler sur des enjeux réels sans renoncer à la proximité.

About ZooStation

ZooStation is specialized in finding the best IT developers in Europe.

Our customer companies introducing developers for permanent or freelance positions;
Ourselves to create a Champions League team of international developers delivering the best software to our customers.

We have a background in IT; understand what's important and do technical assessment before any introduction and we are NEN-4400-1 certified.

Position

About YourExpats

YourExpats is building a new technology platform that makes international employment, immigration and workforce compliance significantly easier for companies and their international employees.

We combine smart software, automation and specialist knowledge to simplify processes that are traditionally complex, manual and fragmented.

We are a small and ambitious team, which means you will not become one developer among dozens of others. You will have a direct influence on the product, technology choices and the experience we create for our customers.

We are looking for an experienced Lead Frontend Developer who wants to help us take our platform to the next level.

The role

As Lead Frontend Developer, you will take ownership of the frontend of the YourExpats platform.

You will work closely with our backend developers and the founders to turn complex workflows into simple, intuitive and professional user experiences.

This is not a role where you simply receive finished designs and convert them into code. We are looking for someone who actively thinks about how a feature should work, how users should interact with it and how the product can become easier and better.

You should therefore combine strong frontend engineering skills with a genuine interest in UX, product design and usability.

What You Will Do

Take technical ownership of our frontend architecture and development.
Build and further develop our platform using React and TypeScript.
Design reusable, scalable and maintainable frontend components.
Integrate the frontend with backend services and REST APIs.
Translate business requirements and complex workflows into intuitive user interfaces.
Improve the overall UX and consistency of the platform.
Think critically about user journeys, interactions, layouts and information architecture.
Work closely with backend developers on API design and implementation.
Review code and establish frontend development standards and best practices.
Improve frontend performance, reliability and maintainability.
Help determine technical and product priorities.
Turn ideas and prototypes into production-ready functionality.
Continuously look for opportunities to make the platform simpler, faster and more user-friendly.
Strong view and willingness to use AI in a structured way with guardrails

Your qualification

You have strong professional experience developing modern web applications and are comfortable taking responsibility for the frontend of a growing SaaS platform.

Ideally, You Have

Extensive professional experience with React. (>3 years at least)
Strong experience with TypeScript.
Solid knowledge of modern JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
Experience building applications that interact heavily with APIs.
Experience structuring larger frontend applications and reusable component libraries.
A strong understanding of responsive web development.
Experience with state management and modern frontend architecture.
Good understanding of authentication, authorization and frontend security principles.
Experience working with Git and modern development workflows.
An eye for detail and a strong sense of UX and visual design.
The ability to work independently and make pragmatic technical decisions.
The confidence to challenge requirements when you see a better solution.
Good communication skills in English.

What Makes You Especially Interesting To Us

You do not have to be a professional UX designer, but you should be the type of developer who immediately notices when:

a workflow contains unnecessary steps;
a screen feels confusing;
information hierarchy could be improved;
a form can be made considerably easier to use;
a design looks inconsistent;
or a technically correct solution simply does not provide a good user experience.

You enjoy solving these problems rather than waiting for someone else to specify every detail.

Experience with Next.js, design systems, Figma, automated testing, CI/CD or SaaS platforms is a plus.

The type of person we are looking for

Because we are a small team, personality and working style are important.

You Are Likely To Enjoy This Role If You

like ownership rather than narrowly defined tasks;
enjoy building products from an early stage;
prefer short communication lines and quick decision-making;
can move between technical detail and the bigger product picture;
are pragmatic and know when something should be perfect and when it simply needs to work well;
enjoy experimenting with new technologies and AI-assisted development;
want your work to have a visible impact on customers and the company.

What we offer

A leading role in the FE development of a unique new technology platform.
Significant influence over frontend architecture, UX and product development.
The opportunity to build rather than maintain a large legacy environment.
A small team with direct communication and little bureaucracy.
A hybrid working model: partly from our office in The Hague and partly from home.
Flexibility and a high level of autonomy.
An international working environment.
The opportunity to grow together with the company and the platform.

International candidates are very welcome. You should, however, be able and willing to work from our office in The Hague on a regular basis.

Additional details

Interested?

If you enjoy combining React, TypeScript, APIs and great UXand would like to play a key role in building a platform from the ground up, we would love to hear from you.

Tell us what you have built, what you are proud of and why this type of product role appeals to you.

About Us

Fidamy is a leading embedded insurance operator, seamlessly integrating innovative non-life insurance products into our partners’ digital and physical customer journeys. Our mission is to help partners generate new revenue streams and build lasting customer loyalty by making insurance simple, accessible, and impactful.

Our engineering team is responsible for building and maintaining the robust infrastructure that powers these embedded insurance solutions. We enable our partners to quickly and reliably integrate insurance offerings through clean, secure integrations and highly reliable production systems.

Solving complex technical challenges in a regulated, data-heavy market dominated by legacy systems is what makes our work both demanding and rewarding. By making insurance integration fast, secure, and developer-friendly, we unlock enormous market potential.

Backed by NN Ventures, Fidamy operates as a high-trust, close-knit engineering team. Our engineers take broad ownership, influence product direction, and create software designed for scale and longevity.

Why Now?

Embedded insurance is at a pivotal point: projected to grow from 1% to 16% of global insurance spend by 2032—a $3 trillion opportunity. Fidamy is moving fast to play a significant role in this transformation. If you are seeking a high-impact engineering role in a scaling startup, now is the time to join us.

What You’ll Do

Build and deliver features across the stack: working on both partner and customer journeys, backend services, and insurance/payment integrations.
Act as the first technical contact during application incidents—whether caused by our services or partner systems—and maintain the dashboards, runbooks, and tools to resolve issues quickly.
Ensure transactional accuracy for crucial flows (pricing, payment, policy issuance) with robust end-to-end testing.
Support commercial deals: respond to technical questions from prospects, set up sandboxes, and assist with integrations.
Own deliverables end-to-end: from design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing iteration.
Leverage AI-driven development tools (including coding agents), write clear specifications and tests, and review outputs with rigor.
Shape the technical roadmap, making pragmatic trade-offs and driving up engineering standards through code reviews.

Our tech stack

AI-driven development: Claude Code and coding agents as standard tooling
Ways of working: test-driven development by default (failing test first), architecture decision records, everything reviewed, shipped continuously
Application: React, Vite, Tailwind, Node.js (TypeScript), Python
Data stores: PostgreSQL, S3, NoSQL
Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform
Observability: OpenTelemetry, with managed tracing and alerting on top
Data & AI: Databricks, AWS Bedrock

Our Culture

Move the Needle: Focus on systems and features with real partner and customer impact.
Master Your Craft: Prioritize deep focus for quality work, encourage knowledge sharing and tech exploration.
Customer Obsession: Work closely with partners to deeply understand and solve their technical challenges.
Be Different: Challenge traditional insurance tech while ensuring enterprise-grade reliability.
Thrive Together: Foster fast-paced innovation balanced with thoughtful execution and collaboration.

What We’re Looking For

Proven experience building and shipping production systems using TypeScript and React, with confidence across the stack.
Test-driven development practitioner, using TDD as a design and quality tool, building systems around domain models, not just database schemas.
Demonstrated ownership of outcomes end-to-end, not just tickets—can show tangible results.
Hands-on in incident response, comfortable handling support queries and resolving system issues independently.
Daily practitioner of AI-driven development: familiar with coding agents, specifications, and iterative refinement.
Experience managing AWS-based systems and interpreting production telemetry.
Entrepreneurial and pragmatic: proactively picks up responsibilities, collaborates cross-functionally, and creates runbooks and documentation as needed.
Disciplined about change management—especially where money, personal data, and compliance are concerned.
Strong communicator, collaborative team player, and able to work directly with partners.
Willingness to work from our Amsterdam office at least two days per week.

Why Join Us

Competitive compensation
Brand new MacBook Pro and equipment
Paid access to Claude Code and in-house AI agent tools for faster, safer shipping
Flexible hybrid work (2-3 days in office)
Visa sponsorship available (including transfer of Dutch visa; no relocation support)
Beautiful Amsterdam office
High autonomy and direct influence on architectural and product direction
Visible impact on strategy, product, and partner outcomes
Fast-track career growth
Close collaboration with company leadership and customers

Ready to Join Us?

We’re building an inclusive team and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds. If you’re motivated by this opportunity—even if you don’t meet every requirement—please apply. What matters most is your excitement for the role and your drive to innovate, take ownership, and help us shape the future of insurance.

Compensation Range: €60K - €80K

originalJobContent:
Op het hoofdkantoor

Bij Albert Heijn werken is niet zomaar een baan. Het is werk met betekenis. Je werkt in een informele cultuur samen met een bevlogen team dat graag voorop wil blijven lopen en verschil wil maken. Met jouw unieke talent maak je impact op het leven van al onze klanten. Je leert van experts in hun vakgebied en we helpen je jouw loopbaan vorm te geven. Je kunt bij ons flexibel werken, zowel vanuit huis als op ons hoofdkantoor in Zaandam. Een baan bij Albert Heijn is niet alleen een baan voor nu, maar ook voor later

Wat betekent dit voor jou?

Word Senior Frontend Engineer (React, Next.js) binnen ons Ad-Tech Cluster!

Retail media is booming en bij ons krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan een geavanceerd platform dat Ahold-merken in Europa en de VS ondersteunt met een volledig retailmedia-aanbod. In deze rol werk je in een high-traffic omgeving aan een schaalbare SaaS-oplossing die door meerdere brands wordt gebruikt en waarmee je direct impact maakt op een snelgroeiend domein. Je komt te werken in een gedreven en ervaren team, met ook ruimte voor gezelligheid.

Albert Heijn vult met 125.000 collega’s, verdeeld over ruim 1.250 winkels in Nederland en Vlaanderen, negen home shop centers, zeven distributiecentra en ons hoofdkantoor elke avond ruim zeven miljoen borden.

Jouw nieuwe baan en werkplek.

Binnen het Ad-Tech Cluster ontwikkelen en implementeren we een retail media SaaS-oplossing voor alle Ahold Delhaize-merken in Europa en de VS. Retail media draait om het verkopen van advertentieruimte op onze digitale kanalen en in de fysieke winkel. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan:

Het promoten van merken zoals Tony’s Chocolonely wanneer een klant zoekt op "chocolade" in onze app of webshop.
Advertenties op grote schermen binnen of buiten de winkel.
Banners met leveranciersbranding op de homepage of categoriepagina’s.
Het verkennen van nieuwe mogelijkheden binnen dit snelgroeiende domein.


Ons cluster, onderdeel van het Customer Tech Platform, is verantwoordelijk voor een flexibele, kostenefficiënte en hoogwaardige retail media suite met uitgebreide functionaliteiten en een groeiend aantal gebruikersmerken.

We hebben de sfeer van een scale-up, verdeeld over 11 teams, waarin je veel ruimte krijgt om initiatief te nemen. Dankzij onze agile werkwijze krijg je de kans om echt impact te maken en je vaardigheden te laten zien.

In deze functie werk je 32-40 uren per week, deels vanuit ons kantoor in Zaandam en deels vanuit huis.

Dit ga je als Senior Frontend Developer bij ons doen.

Je durft je stem te laten horen wanneer dat nodig is en brengt jouw mening actief naar voren. Assertiviteit en een proactieve houding zijn essentieel in deze rol!
Je sluit je aan bij een agile team en neemt eigenaarschap over specifieke productgebieden binnen onze suite.
Je verbetert bestaande functionaliteiten en ontwikkelt nieuwe features, met oog op de behoeften van een breed scala aan merken.
Je werkt nauw samen met de product owner en je team, en denkt actief mee over innovatieve features en het gebruik van nieuwe technologieën.
Je gaat de uitdaging aan om een SaaS-oplossing te bouwen die geschikt is voor meerdere retailers.
Je hebt oog voor kwaliteit en hecht veel waarde aan geautomatiseerde end-to-end tests.
Je kijkt verder dan je eigen component en houdt rekening met de totale product suite.


We vinden het belangrijk dat jij bij Albert Heijn jezelf kunt zijn in een omgeving die openstaat voor verschillende perspectieven, een omgeving waarin we nieuwsgierig zijn en elkaar waarderen. Voor deze functie zoeken we bij voorkeur iemand die de diversiteit in ons team, in de breedste zin van het woord, versterkt. Iemand die vanuit eigen achtergrond en persoonlijke eigenschappen een ander geluid brengt en daarmee een goede aanvulling is op ons team.

Dit bieden we jou.

Een jaarsalaris tot €105K, inclusief vakantiegeld en een flexibele bonus. Afhankelijk van je ervaring.
Je werkt mee aan onze groei en ontvangt daarom een variabele bonus bovenop je salaris.
20 vakantiedagen
Een keuzebudget, dat ingezet kan worden voor 12,5 extra vrije dagen. Anders kan je dit budget ruilen voor kortingen of laten uitbetalen. Jij beslist.
Een uitstekende pensioenregeling bij het Ahold Delhaize Pensioenfonds.
Een reiskostenvergoeding of NS-trajectkaart om van en naar Zaandam te reizen.
10% korting op je boodschappen bij Albert Heijn, tot maximaal €300 per jaar.
Een Mijn Albert Heijn Premium abonnement met vele voordelen.
Via onze Albert Heijn Deals ontvang je exclusieve kortingen op leuke uitjes en producten van grote merken.
Een inclusieve omgeving waarin je op persoonlijk en vakinhoudelijk vlak continu kan blijven ontwikkelen.


Dit breng je mee.

Met onze 125.000 collega’s vullen we elke avond ruim zeven miljoen borden. En als het aan ons ligt, doen we dat binnenkort ook samen met jou als onze nieuwe Senior Frontend Developer. Zeker als je React.js en Next.js naar Albert Heijn meebrengt. Ook heb je:

Een proactieve houding
8+ jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare rol
Up-to-date kennis van het huidige JavaScript-landschap
Ervaring met het optimaliseren van de performance en technische kwaliteit van complexe applicaties
Ruime ervaring met React.js en Next.js
Een duidelijke visie op component-based architecture
Inzicht in en ervaring met server-side rendering (SSR) in Next.js
Ervaring met Tailwind CSS
De vaardigheden om efficiënte en herbruikbare UI-componenten te bouwen
Ervaring met Git & GitHub, versiebeheer, code reviews en pull request workflows
Ervaring met zowel unit tests als end-to-end (E2E) testing


Daarnaast ben je:

Ervaring met werken in een monorepository, bijvoorbeeld met tools als Nx of Turborepo
Ervaring met het beheren van shared components en modules binnen een grote codebase
Kennis van en ervaring met het onderhouden van GitHub Actions


Samen beter eten bereikbaar maken. Voor iedereen.

Bij Albert Heijn geloven we dat eten en drinken een essentiële rol speelt bij de grote uitdagingen in de maatschappij. Het levert een belangrijke bijdrage aan een gezonde levensstijl, het verbindt mensen en draagt bij aan een beter klimaat en daarmee een duurzame samenleving. Onze missie is dan ook: Samen beter eten bereikbaar maken. Voor iedereen.

Albert Heijn Nederland is B Corp gecertificeerd. Deze certificering onderstreept onze missie waarmee het een bijdrage levert aan een gezonde, sociale en duurzame samenleving. De B Corp certificering wordt toegekend aan bedrijven die voldoen aan hoge normen voor sociale- en milieuprestaties, transparantie en wettelijke verantwoordelijkheid.

Klaar om samen onze missie waar te maken?

Klik op de sollicitatiebutton om te solliciteren. Dat kan ook als je nét niet alle artikelen van ons boodschappenlijstje in huis hebt. Wil je liever eerst meer weten? Neem contact met ons op!

At Optiver, we’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our Global Talent Assessment Tooling Team (GTAT), the cornerstone of our global recruitment, engaging 100,000+ users annually. With expertise in server-side platforms and a genuine interest in UI/UX, you'll contribute to the full software development lifecycle of our global platforms, serving as the central hub for all talent assessments, training and education activities, and test authorization. Join us in shaping the future of global talent acquisition at Optiver.

Who We Are

Optiver’s story began over 30 years ago, when we started business as a single trader on the floor of Amsterdam’s options exchange. Today, we are at the forefront of trading and technology as a leading global electronic market maker, focused on pricing, execution and risk management.

What You’ll Do

As a Software Engineer, you’ll be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining our talent assessment tooling platform and our assessments. This critical infrastructure is key to our ability to hire at scale and speed, representing one of the first interactions individuals have with Optiver during their recruitment journey. You’ll work within a dynamic team to ensure the platform's scalability and reliability, contributing to the success of our global talent assessment initiatives. You’ll work closely with our recruitment teams globally on a day to day basis to ensure that the platform is scalable, reliable, and user-friendly.

Some of what you’ll do day to day:


Design, develop and maintain our assessment tooling platform and features supporting recruitment
Collaborate with recruitment teams on a global scale to ensure that the platform is scalable, reliable, and user-friendly
Write clean, maintainable code that is easy to understand and modify and participate in code reviews to ensure that code meets quality standards
Utilize frontend technologies (React/Angular) to enhance user interfaces and experiences.

Strong technical background consisting of 3+ years of experience in full stack development
Proficiency in server-side development utilizing C# .NET or Python
Experience with relational databases (e.g. PostgreSQL or SQL Server)
Experience with frontend technologies including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frontend frameworks
A proactive approach to problem solving and an entrepreneurial attitude
Ability to clearly explain your thoughts through written and verbal communication, ask the right questions, and work collaboratively with a range of technical and non technical stakeholders

Experience with server hosting on cloud providers (e.g. AWS)


What You'll Get

You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, where you’ll be surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem solvers. Motivated by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high-performing environment alongside talented colleagues, working collectively to tackle the toughest problems in the financial markets.

In addition, you’ll receive:


A performance-based bonus structure unmatched anywhere in the industry. We combine our profits across desks, teams and offices into a global profit pool.
The opportunity to work alongside best-in-class professionals from over 50 different countries.
25 paid vacation days in your first year, increasing to 30 from your second year onwards.
Training opportunities, discounts on health insurance, and fully paid first-class commuting expenses.
Extensive office perks, including breakfast, lunch and dinner, world-class barista coffee, in-house physio and chair massages, organised sports and leisure activities, and Friday afternoon drinks.
Training and continuous learning opportunities, including access to conferences and tech events.
Competitive relocation packages and visa sponsorship where necessary for expats.


WHO WE ARE:

At Optiver, our mission is to constantly improve the market by injecting liquidity, providing accurate pricing, increasing transparency and acting as a stabilizing force no matter the market conditions. With a focus on continuous improvement, we participate in the safeguarding of healthy and efficient markets for everyone who participates. As one of the largest market making institutions, we are a trusted partner of 70+ exchanges across the globe.

.

We do not require any assistance from third-parties including agencies in the recruitment of this role.

Optiver is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

About Picnic

Building the supermarket on wheels

Started in 2015 in the Netherlands, Picnic now delivers groceries to millions across three countries, growing fast. The idea? We’re bringing back the milkman. Imagine personal service and fresh products but in a modern, sustainable way. We’re looking for bright minds to shape the future of grocery shopping with us. Ready to join the revolution?

Tech at Picnic

At Picnic we merge advanced technology with a customer-centric approach. We aim to create a simple, affordable, and enjoyable grocery shopping experience. Work on various aspects like our mobile app, store backend, internal development platforms, delivery routing, warehouse logistics, and ML models – all built in-house. We’re looking for problem-solvers who thrive in a collaborative environment. We are open to junior and experienced software, data and ML engineers. Our diverse team welcomes innovative and bold ideas.

Picnic perks

With a diverse team of over 80 nationalities, you’re sure to find your people
You’ll work in an awesome scaleup environment with the freedom to drive your own projects and create a visible impact

“At Picnic, we build the technology that powers the transition towards a sustainable food

supply chain where we delight customers with more choice, fresher products, and less

waste. The team behind this innovation loves to crack hard problems, uses data to

explore unbeaten paths, and strives to stay ahead of the curve in this fast-paced

industry.”

– Daniel Gebler, CTO

Want to learn more? Check out our blogs!

Position

In a nutshell

At Picnic, we’re redefining how people buy groceries by making shopping effortless, sustainable, and fun! Our Consumer domain is at the heart of this transformation, creating customer-facing features that delight millions of users across Europe.

From developing personalized shopping experiences, like our Meal Planner, to building engaging loyalty programs, we focus on delivering a high-quality, intuitive user experience by building scalable solutions with the latest tech. If you’re passionate about building impactful products used by millions daily, this is the place for you!

Tricks of the trade

Ownership: Take ownership of projects from concept to production. Work collaboratively, grow alongside your team, and contribute to the team’s success.
Impact: Develop solutions that make shopping smarter, faster, and more intuitive. Your code will power seamless, scalable, and personalized interactions for millions of users.
Agility: Thrive in a fast-paced environment where you learn and use a wide variety of tools and platforms to build the best tech for our customers.
Platform thinking: Build technology that empowers developers and business analysts alike to develop flexible features. (Check out our blog post!)
Our Tech: You’ll work with Java and TypeScript on a daily basis, using frameworks like Spring (Spring with Spring Boot, Reactor, Immutables) and React. Supporting this core stack are GraalVM, Apache Calcite, Maven, Python 3.x, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Helm, Terraform, Vault, and Datadog.

Your qualification

You have a Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology, Computer Engineering or a related technical field.
You have 2-5 years of professional experience in Java.
You have a product mindset and treat technology as a means to an end, owning and solving business problems by choosing the best-fitting technical solutions and tools for each challenge.
You have experience with AI tooling and are comfortable with agentic engineering.
Your English skills are on point (no Dutch required).

What we offer

Every expert was once a beginner!

You’ll get plenty of opportunities to challenge yourself and grow, including the Picnic Tech Academy, Lunch & Learn sessions, and tailored soft skills training. We also offer free professional weekly language courses.

Make a difference

You’ll work in an awesome startup environment with the freedom to drive your own projects and create a visible impact. Our fully electric vehicles and sustainable business model mean you’ll also be contributing to making the world a better place!

Teamwork makes the dream work

With more than 80 nationalities across 3 countries, you’ll be part of a diverse company with plenty of cool stuff to get involved with, from board game evenings to after-work drinks to our company ski trip and more!

You are what you eat

You’ll get freshly prepared, healthy lunches and snacks (with plenty of vegetarian, vegan, and halal options). Coffee snob? Don’t worry, our amazing Picnic barista has you covered.

Stay healthy

Mental health is important. As well as having the option to speak with Picnic colleagues who act as confidential advisors, our collaboration with OpenUp gives you easy access to professional psychologists, along with workshops and materials. There are plenty of sports communities and events to get involved with, from tennis to yoga, to climbing!

Attractive package

We offer competitive compensation and a pension plan that looks out for your future self, as well as 25 vacation days per year, so you can recharge your batteries

Benefits for expats

It can be daunting starting a new job AND moving to a new country. That’s why we offer lots of support for our many expat colleagues, if you want to find our relocation benefits, see here.

Full Stack Engineer
Bonafi B.V. · Rotterdam · Full-time, on-site · Start 01/11

Before you apply
You need to already live in the Netherlands and have the right to work here.
We cannot offer relocation but can offer visa sponsorship for this role
We work from our office in Rotterdam five days a week. This is not a remote or hybrid position.
We are in an intense stage of the company. The contract is for 40 hours per week, but in practice the team currently works considerably more at times, including some evenings and occasional weekends. We prefer to be transparent about that upfront, so you know what the current reality looks like.

About Bonafi
Bonafi is building the operating system for modern family offices.
Families with €10 million or more in wealth often manage their financial lives across banks, accountants, asset managers, funds, legal entities and advisers. Information is fragmented, administration is largely manual and no system has a complete, continuously updated view.
We are building that system.

The first layer is the financial record: one place for the complete wealth structure, with every number traceable back to its original source. The next layer is execution. Bonafi will increasingly take over the operational work that family offices and advisers still perform manually today: processing reports, tracking obligations, preparing payments, following up on missing information and handling administration across entities and asset classes.

Over time, we believe a significant part of what is currently delivered by a network of advisers can be handled by software, with human experts involved where judgment is genuinely required.
We started Bonafi in April 2026. Today, we are a team of five, have €120k+ in contracted ARR and are fully ISO compliant.

We are still early, but the ambition is large: to build the infrastructure on which the next generation of family offices runs.

What you will work on
You will work across the product, but much of the role will be backend and AI infrastructure.
This includes:
Building document extraction pipelines that turn reports, statements and other unstructured documents into reliable structured data.
 Modeling clients, legal entities, assets, valuations and cash flows across different asset classes.
Building the infrastructure around our AI systems: tool use, routing, evaluations, guardrails and human review for cases where the system should not act autonomously.
Integrating banks, custodians, accounting software, fund administrators and other financial systems.
Building and improving parts of the frontend when needed.

You will not be limited to a narrowly defined set of tickets. We usually start with a customer problem and expect engineers to help determine how to solve it.

Our stack
Our main stack is:
Python and FastAPI
TypeScript, React and Next.js
PostgreSQL
GCP, with production infrastructure in Eemshaven
Cloudflare R2
Vercel in Frankfurt
Claude through Vertex AI
Voyage for embeddings

All production compute and client data remain within the EU. That is a hard requirement for our infrastructure and architecture.

What we are looking for
We are looking for someone with at least three years of professional software engineering experience, preferably working on products used by real customers in production.
You should be comfortable with:
Python: FastAPI, async programming, typing, testing and data processing.
TypeScript and React/Next.js: enough to independently build and ship product features from backend to frontend.
SQL and data modelling: including designing schemas for complex and imperfect real-world domains.
LLM-based systems: such as retrieval, structured extraction, agent workflows and evaluation.
Experience with financial software, Dutch tax, accounting or wealth management is useful, but not required.
Our working language is English, so you need to be comfortable communicating and working in English.

Compensation and benefits
The salary range for this role is €4,000 to €5,500 gross per month, depending on experience, excluding 8% holiday allowance.
In addition:
0.3% to 0.6% equity in the form of certificates through our STAK. This is the same structure used for our founding engineers. 25% vests after completion of your first contract, with the remainder vesting monthly over the following three years.
We do not track vacation days, but in the contract we incorporate: 24 holidays per year, in addition to Dutch public holidays.
MacBook Pro for work.
Swapfiets.
Gym membership in consultation.
Dinner at the office when we work late.

We start with a 12-month contract, with the intention to continue afterwards if it works well for both sides.

Hiring process
Our hiring process is straightforward:
A 30-minute conversation with Cecé.
A technical case at our office in Rotterdam.
A trial day under NDA, working with the actual Bonafi codebase.
An offer if both sides want to continue.

We aim to complete the process within two weeks.

Apply
Apply through this page with your CV and/or GitHub profile and a few lines about the most difficult thing you have shipped.

Microservices architecture utilizing the latest versions of C#/.NET.

Azure DevOps.

Reqnroll, Playwright.

Working at GreenFlux means working in a dynamic, innovative, and informal organization, where new ideas and developments move quickly and each day brings new opportunities and challenges. Behind our platform is a team of exceptionally talented people, remote-first and globally distributed across 16+ countries. We have flexibility in terms of the problems we work on
We own the full lifecycle of our projects

listingContent:
Lead Product Designer
Lead Product Designer

Amsterdam, North Holland, Netherlands
2 days ago
title: Lead Product Designer
originalJobContent:
Secfi is building the private wealth stack for employees with equity.

The Problem We're Solving
Private markets are where most wealth is created today, and they're notoriously hard for individuals to navigate. The best financial advice has always been a luxury, reserved for the ultra-wealthy, delivered by private bankers.

And even those who can afford an advisor often find that most have a blind spot when it comes to pre-IPO company equity & stock options. It's a black box for most in the industry.

Meanwhile, startup employees give years of their lives. Intense work, real sacrifice. Then the company finally has its exit, and they get burned.

They pay more tax than they need to. They don’t have access to private bank liquidity solutions. They mishandle their shares. They can leave millions on the table, on the single biggest financial decision of their life.

We're changing that. Secfi is putting sophisticated equity strategy in the hands of the people building the world's most innovative companies.

We work with the builders behind the best tech companies on the planet. We're doubling revenue year on year, growing AUM at over 200%, and we're trusted by employees from companies like Canva, Stripe, SpaceX, Databricks and Anthropic.

We're indirectly invested in more than half the IPOs of the biggest tech brands you know, and we help the people who built them with something deeply personal: their finances.

Why Now?
We're at an inflection point. Demand is climbing, and we're expanding fast on all fronts. A great fintech is a blend of financial products and technology, and we're pushing hard on each.

The financial products. The financing and wealth platforms that already drive our revenue, with a fast-growing user base. Now we're deepening them. Automating what's still manual, shipping the features that turn a strong business into a category leader.

The technology. Maeve is our agentic financial planner, and it's becoming the interface for everything Secfi does. Not a feature bolted onto the side, but the hub: the connective layer between our financing, wealth and planning products, and the way customers interact with all of it.

And the brand. We're about to go through a rebrand with an external agency, with a lot of work downstream of it. We're also looking hard at where we go next on mobile.

Which means the person who joins now isn't inheriting years of accumulated decisions and nudging margins. There's a rare window here to shape how the whole thing looks and feels.
It's early enough that the biggest problems are still unsolved. The people who join now are the ones who'll solve them.

About The Role
We're looking for a Lead Product Designer to own design at Secfi.

You'd be the second designer, working alongside an experienced product designer who's remote. The design function is small and still taking shape, which is the opportunity. We're not looking for a second pair of hands. We're looking for something closer to a founding designer: someone who takes the space, sets the standard, and treats the product as theirs.

You'll report to our Head of Product & Tech, who spent his career as a designer and design director before this. Design conversations here happen in substance. You won't need to translate your decisions into executive-speak to be heard, and you won't be the only person in the room who cares whether it's right.

This is roughly 90% product design and 10% brand - a landing page, a campaign visual, the occasional pitch slide. You won't be hired for brand work, but some of it comes with the territory.

And the hard part of this job isn't the pixels. Someone's single largest asset is usually a stake in a company that has no public price. Working out what to do with it means holding several things at once: what it's worth today and what it might be worth later, what it costs to exercise, what tax falls due and when (often years before any money actually arrives), and how all of that shifts if they change jobs, move country, or the company raises again. Then you have to make it legible on a screen to someone brilliant who has never wanted to think about any of it.

You'll need to open the model and understand the maths. If numbers and spreadsheets make you want to leave the room, this won't be the role for you. If the opposite is true, there aren't many problems this good.

What You'll Own
Maeve. How customers interact with our AI planner - how it shows up, when it speaks, and how trust gets built into an interface where an LLM is advising on money. Still being defined. You'll define a lot of it.

The portfolio value tracker. Our flagship surface, moving from a static valuation view to a live one: real-time pricing signals, market news, AI-generated insight. The problem is making an increasingly rich stream of information legible instead of overwhelming. Information design meeting financial UX.

The core product. Equity planning tools, onboarding and financing flows used by tens of thousands of people. Keeping them sharp matters as much as shipping new things.

The rebrand, and everything downstream of it. A new identity is coming, and a lot follows it - the design system, the product surfaces, the website. You'll take the lead on bringing it through into the product, and own the relationship with the agency alongside your manager.

Experience You Need
Consumer product design craft. You've shipped B2C products where design quality visibly mattered. Complex B2B alongside that is a plus. Purely B2B won't work here, and neither will a career spent entirely in e-commerce. We need someone who's designed against real complexity.

Comfort with hard problems. Financial, quantitative, technical - the domain matters less than the evidence that you thrive working with difficult problems, and that you can hold a complicated system in your head and make it simple on screen.

0→1. Initial concept through to detailed design and shipped product. This usually means recent startup or scale-up experience.

A strong generalist. You do your own prototyping and your own user testing. If you've always had a research team to hand work to, this will feel like a shock.

AI-forward. You already use AI in your own workflow and you're fluent in what's currently possible - Claude Code for prototyping, Figma Make, wiring prototypes back into Figma. You tend to find the new tool before the team does.

Around 8 years' experience. We're less interested in the number than in the maturity: how you approach the work, the team, and reason.

A degree. Design, art, architecture or something adjacent - or a master's from a good school in something else entirely and a deliberate move into design. We want evidence you studied something properly.

Fluent English. You'll be discussing design decisions with engineers, PMs and executive layer.

Bonus Points
Financial product experience. Brokers, fintech, trading. We don't expect you to arrive knowing equity, vesting or tax, most of our team didn't. But if you've designed for money before, it helps.

Mobile app design. Our platform is web-based and responsive today, and mobile is somewhere we're actively looking. We rate a mobile lens highly regardless: designers who've worked with less real estate tend to simplify rather than fill.

Design system experience. You'll own and evolve ours. Having built one from scratch is a plus; being comfortable improving one matters more.

Brand and marketing range, and visible taste. Plenty of product designers can make a system-compliant screen and then produce an ugly landing page. We try to add a tasteful layer to everything, and we'll be looking for evidence you can too.

3D. Some is coming in the new branding. Optional, but if you enjoy Blender you'll use it here.

Practicalities
Location - Amsterdam, 3 days a week (Monday, Tuesday, Thursday)
Contract - 1 year Dutch contract, indefinite thereafter
Eligibility - We sponsor work visa, process 30% ruling & relocate (relocation credit provided)
Comp - €90 – €110K (including 8% holiday allowance) + pension contribution + bonus + stock

What's In It For You?
A manager with design background. Your manager was a designer before he ran product and technology. For an experienced designer this is the difference between defending your work and discussing it. Feedback here is specific, and craft is understood rather than reacted to.

A rebrand. Most senior design roles are maintenance dressed up as ownership. This one isn't. You'll arrive right as the identity changes, with the product surfaces, the design system and the website all to be brought through it.

Ownership, and room to shape the function. You'll own real surfaces from day one and help define how design works as the team grows. No layers, no committee, no design-by-consensus.

Users who'll make you better. Founders, executives and early employees at the best tech companies in the world. They put craft into their own products and they expect it back. They notice.

A problem worth solving. Equity, tax, valuation and financial planning, wired into an agentic product where the answer has to be right every time. It's hard. That's the appeal, and it's also the filter.

A business that's working. Profitable, doubling revenue year on year with 60k+ users. You're building from strength, not sprinting ahead of a runway.

How we work. Amsterdam office 3 days a week with your product and engineering teammates. Up to 4–6 weeks fully remote a year. Lunch on office days. Company trips. High trust, high standards. We iterate fast, we're not afraid to kill ideas, and we work hard. But we look after our people; this isn't a place that mistakes long hours for good work.

Hiring Process
Step 1: 30 minute call with our internal Talent Partner
Step 2: 45 minute call with our Head of Product & Tech
Step 3: Panel style design session with some of our team
Step 4: Final convo with our CEO to ensure all questions are answered & offer

Je verbetert bestaande functionaliteiten en ontwikkelt nieuwe features, met oog op de behoeften van een breed scala aan merken.
Je werkt nauw samen met de product owner en je team, en denkt actief mee over innovatieve features en het gebruik van nieuwe technologieën.
Je gaat de uitdaging aan om een SaaS-oplossing te bouwen die geschikt is voor meerdere retailers.
Je hebt oog voor kwaliteit en hecht veel waarde aan geautomatiseerde end-to-end tests.
Je kijkt verder dan je eigen component en houdt rekening met de totale product suite.

We vinden het belangrijk dat jij bij Albert Heijn jezelf kunt zijn in een omgeving die openstaat voor verschillende perspectieven, een omgeving waarin we nieuwsgierig zijn en elkaar waarderen. Voor deze functie zoeken we bij voorkeur iemand die de diversiteit in ons team, in de breedste zin van het woord, versterkt. Iemand die vanuit eigen achtergrond en persoonlijke eigenschappen een ander geluid brengt en daarmee een goede aanvulling is op ons team.

Dit bieden we jou.
Een jaarsalaris tot €105K, inclusief vakantiegeld en een flexibele bonus. Afhankelijk van je ervaring.
Je werkt mee aan onze groei en ontvangt daarom een variabele bonus bovenop je salaris.
20 vakantiedagen
Een keuzebudget, dat ingezet kan worden voor 12,5 extra vrije dagen. Anders kan je dit budget ruilen voor kortingen of laten uitbetalen. Jij beslist.
Een uitstekende pensioenregeling bij het Ahold Delhaize Pensioenfonds.
Een reiskostenvergoeding of NS-trajectkaart om van en naar Zaandam te reizen.
10% korting op je boodschappen bij Albert Heijn, tot maximaal €300 per jaar.
Een Mijn Albert Heijn Premium abonnement met vele voordelen.
Via onze Albert Heijn Deals ontvang je exclusieve kortingen op leuke uitjes en producten van grote merken.
Een inclusieve omgeving waarin je op persoonlijk en vakinhoudelijk vlak continu kan blijven ontwikkelen.

Dit breng je mee.
Met onze 125.000 collega’s vullen we elke avond ruim zeven miljoen borden. En als het aan ons ligt, doen we dat binnenkort ook samen met jou als onze nieuwe Senior Frontend Developer. Zeker als je React.js en Next.js naar Albert Heijn meebrengt. Ook heb je:
Een proactieve houding
8+ jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare rol
Up-to-date kennis van het huidige JavaScript-landschap
Ervaring met het optimaliseren van de performance en technische kwaliteit van complexe applicaties
Ruime ervaring met React.js en Next.js
Een duidelijke visie op component-based architecture
Inzicht in en ervaring met server-side rendering (SSR) in Next.js
Ervaring met Tailwind CSS
De vaardigheden om efficiënte en herbruikbare UI-componenten te bouwen
Ervaring met Git & GitHub, versiebeheer, code reviews en pull request workflows
Ervaring met zowel unit tests als end-to-end (E2E) testing

Daarnaast ben je:
Ervaring met werken in een monorepository, bijvoorbeeld met tools als Nx of Turborepo
Ervaring met het beheren van shared components en modules binnen een grote codebase
Kennis van en ervaring met het onderhouden van GitHub Actions

Samen beter eten bereikbaar maken. Voor iedereen.
Bij Albert Heijn geloven we dat eten en drinken een essentiële rol speelt bij de grote uitdagingen in de maatschappij. Het levert een belangrijke bijdrage aan een gezonde levensstijl, het verbindt mensen en draagt bij aan een beter klimaat en daarmee een duurzame samenleving. Onze missie is dan ook: Samen beter eten bereikbaar maken. Voor iedereen.

Albert Heijn Nederland is B Corp gecertificeerd. Deze certificering onderstreept onze missie waarmee het een bijdrage levert aan een gezonde, sociale en duurzame samenleving. De B Corp certificering wordt toegekend aan bedrijven die voldoen aan hoge normen voor sociale- en milieuprestaties, transparantie en wettelijke verantwoordelijkheid.

Klaar om samen onze missie waar te maken?

title: UI/UX Developer, Platform UI Team - Netherlands
originalJobContent:
Role in one sentence

A UI/UX developer who designs and builds the front end of a new integration product with a node-based, AI-assisted design. The role turns complex technical workflows into a simple, usable interface.

Why this profile

This is a greenfield build. The product has no existing front end to inherit or extend. This person takes user interaction and design guidance and turns it directly into working code. Design and code stay in one continuous loop.

Must-haves

5–9 years of experience in UI/UX development, with real ownership of shipped, complex products.
Strong hands-on experience with React and Next.js. Builds and maintains component libraries.
Experience building node-based or canvas-style interfaces. Drag, connect, wire, zoom, pan. Familiar with libraries like React Flow, or has built equivalent canvas interactions from scratch.
Experience designing multi-mode interfaces. The same product adapts to different user types and still feels like one coherent product.
Comfortable with real-time UI: WebSocket-driven updates, live logs, streaming states, optimistic UI.
Experience building complex dynamic forms, validation (e.g., React Hook Form, Zod), and multi-step drawer/modal workflows for deeply configurable nodes.
Strong grasp of design systems: typography, spacing, component consistency, dark-mode theming, accessible color contrast.
Works directly from a REST API. Understands API contracts and flags gaps early.
Solid UX fundamentals: information hierarchy, progressive disclosure, error states, empty states, loading states. Designs for edge cases with the same care as the main flow.
Reviews own designs critically and explains interaction choices with clear reasoning.
Fluent English. Works well in a small, fast-moving technical team.

Nice-to-haves

Exposure to workflow builder UX patterns (e.g., data mapping/field wiring, payload schema previews, or step-by-step execution debugging).
Familiarity with canvas performance optimization techniques (managing high node/edge counts without FPS drops) and state management libraries (e.g., Zustand, Redux).
Familiarity with Node.js runtime environments and full-stack JavaScript workflows, aiding local prototyping and API mocking.
Familiarity with conversational/chat UI patterns - keeping a chat panel and a visual canvas in sync.
Experience with AI-assisted products - showing confidence scores, model output, or human-review/approval gates in a UI.
Familiarity with FastAPI or similar Python backends- reads endpoint docs and reasons about data shape.
Exposure to workflow/automation tools (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier, Retool) as a user or builder.
Experience designing for a technical, developer-facing audience - comfort with technical typography systems (e.g., IBM Plex Sans/Mono).

Tech stack

Frontend: React, Next.js
Backend/API: Node.js, REST + WebSocket, OpenAPI-based
Visual canvas: Node/edge-based workflow builder (React Flow or equivalent)
Styling: Component-based design system, dark-mode-first, technical typography
Auth: OIDC/OAuth2

We are looking forward to receiving your application, but please note, that only applicants with an EU citizenship or a valid residency/work permit will be considered for this role.

originalJobContent:
Utrecht | 32 - 40 uur p/w | € 5.000 - € 7.000

Word onderdeel van een community waar developers centraal staan.
Je bent een ervaren Frontend React Developer. Je wilt werken aan uitdagende opdrachten, blijven groeien in je vak en werken bij een werkgever die jou ziet als developer, niet als een nummer.

Bij Codefield sta jij centraal. Samen kiezen we opdrachten die aansluiten bij jouw technische ambities, interesses en een gezonde werk-privébalans. Zo combineer je uitdagende projecten bij opdrachtgevers van Codefield met de zekerheid van een vast contract en de betrokkenheid van een hechte developer community.

Work. Game. Grow.
Dat is waar wij voor staan. Je wordt onderdeel van een community van ruim 25 ervaren developers, waar kennis delen, persoonlijke groei en plezier hand in hand gaan. Tijdens DEV-Days en kennissessies ontwikkel je jezelf technisch én persoonlijk, afgewisseld met teamuitjes, spelavonden, een familiedag en jaarlijkse teamweekenden. Zo bouw je niet alleen aan impactvolle applicaties en software, maar ook aan een team waar je graag onderdeel van bent.

Wat je gaat doen
Als Senior Frontend React Developer werk je aan opdrachten die aansluiten bij jouw technische ambities. Samen kijken we naar de techniek, de organisatie, de reisafstand en de manier van werken, zodat jij terechtkomt op een plek waar je energie van krijgt. Daarom werk je in de meeste gevallen hybride en ben je maximaal twee dagen per week op locatie.

Je ontwikkelt moderne React-applicaties, herbruikbare componenten en interactieve gebruikersinterfaces met de nieuwste React-, Next.js- en frontendtechnologieën. Je denkt actief mee over frontend-architectuur, bouwt schaalbare en toegankelijke oplossingen en schrijft kwalitatieve, onderhoudbare code die klaar is voor productie. Met unit- en end-to-end testing, code reviews en bewezen engineering best practices draag je bij aan betrouwbare, snelle en gebruiksvriendelijke software die dagelijks door duizenden gebruikers wordt gebruikt.

Naast je opdrachten blijf je jezelf continu ontwikkelen. Je verdiept je in de nieuwste React-features, AI-tools en frontendontwikkelingen en deelt je kennis binnen de Codefield-community tijdens DEV-Days, kennissessies en andere technische events. Zo blijf je niet alleen vooroplopen in je vak, maar help je ook je collega's verder groeien.

Wat je van ons krijgt
Salaris tussen € 5.000 en € 7.000 per maand.
Direct een vast contract

25 vakantiedagen, 8,33% vakantiegeld en de mogelijkheid om 6 extra vakantiedagen bij te kopen
Betaald sabbaticalprogramma: 2 weken extra verlof na 2 jaar en 1 maand na 5 jaar
Volop ruimte en budget voor opleidingen, trainingen en Microsoft-certificeringen
€5.000 onboardingbudget voor je laptop, workgear en thuiswerkplek
DEV Community Days, wekelijkse borrels, padel, teamactiviteiten en een jaarlijks teamweekend
Een modern kantoor in Utrecht met goede koffie, een gameroom (simrig, PS5, pooltafel en dartbord) en volop ruimte om collega's te ontmoeten.

Technologieën waar je mee werkt
Geen opdracht is hetzelfde. Daarom werk je niet altijd met exact dezelfde technologieën. Afhankelijk van de opdrachtgever en het project kom je regelmatig onderstaande technieken tegen. Je hoeft niet overal ervaring mee te hebben, maar je vindt het leuk om jezelf hierin verder te ontwikkelen.
React
HTML, Javascript, Next.js, SCSS, Storybook, Typescript, Web Components
Context API, Redux Toolkit, Tanstack Query, Zustand
GraphQL, RESTful APIs
Cypress, Jest, Playwright, Vitest
Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Git, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes
AWS, Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure
AI assisted development, GitHub Copilot

Dit breng jij mee
Je bent een ervaren Frontend React Developer die verder kijkt dan alleen code. Je denkt graag mee over technische keuzes, neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwaliteit van software en krijgt energie van samenwerken met andere developers. Je blijft jezelf ontwikkelen en vindt het leuk om jouw kennis te delen.

Voor deze rol vragen we:
Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Frontend Developer, waarvan meerdere jaren met React.
Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde hbo-bacheloropleiding.
Je hebt ruime ervaring met React, Next.js, TypeScript, HTML en SCSS.
Je voelt je thuis binnen Agile-, Scrum- en DevOps-teams.
Je denkt verder dan alleen code en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor kwaliteit, toegankelijkheid, performance en onderhoudbaarheid.

Herken je jezelf niet in ieder punt, maar denk je dat Codefield goed bij jou past? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Interesse?
Klaar voor een werkgever waar persoonlijke aandacht en jouw ontwikkeling net zo belangrijk zijn als de software die je bouwt? Solliciteer direct of neem contact op met Dave Tak. Wij nemen binnen 1 werkdag contact met je op.

originalJobContent:
Webfuse is Surfly’s browser-based platform for securely adding functionality, automation, and collaboration to existing web applications without changing their source code. It combines JavaScript sandboxing with proxy infrastructure, creating unusual engineering challenges across browser APIs, web security, real-time communication, and distributed systems.

As a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer, you will join our Product Engineering team in Amsterdam. This is a genuinely full-stack role: projects regularly cross frontend and backend boundaries.

You will own production features from technical design and implementation through testing, release, and maintenance. Your work will include a mix of:

Building in-session interfaces and tools using TypeScript and Vue.js
Developing APIs and backend services using Python, Django, Django REST Framework, Node.js, and Go
Building real-time collaboration features using WebSockets and WebRTC
Developing browser automation, in-session extensions, and security controls
Building integrations with customer and partner systems
Developing MCP and WebMCP capabilities that allow AI agents to interact with Webfuse sessions


Testing, debugging, deployment, and production maintenance are part of owning a feature - not separate responsibilities handed to another team.

We expect you to bring deep expertise in at least one part of the stack and to contribute confidently across the wider platform. As part of a small engineering team, you will have direct influence over technical decisions and how features are built.

Our team is international and English is our working language. This is an office-first hybrid role: you will work from our Amsterdam office four days per week, with the option to work from home one day per week.

Candidates must currently be based in the Netherlands. Surfly can provide or transfer Dutch visa sponsorship.

A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical field
At least five years of professional software engineering experience building and maintaining production web applications
Direct experience with Python, Django, Vue.js, Node.js, or Go
Strong full-stack development experience, with deeper expertise in either backend or frontend engineering
Professional experience with server-side development and TypeScript-based frontend development
Experience designing, building, and maintaining APIs or backend services
Strong engineering fundamentals, including automated testing, debugging, code review, Git, and maintainable software design
The ability to investigate complex problems across browser, frontend, and backend systems
A track record of owning software beyond its initial implementation, including rollout, debugging, and production maintenance
Clear written and verbal communication in English
Currently based in the Netherlands and able to work from our Amsterdam office four days per week
A GitHub profile containing publicly viewable code that you wrote


Nice to have:

Browser automation experience with Playwright, Puppeteer, or the Chrome DevTools Protocol
Knowledge of CSP, cookies, SameSite, SRI, or cross-origin isolation
Experience with WebSockets, WebRTC, or browser extension development
Experience with PostgreSQL, Redis, microservices, containers, or deployment pipelines
Experience with MCP, WebMCP, or other AI-agent integrations
