originalJobContent:
Remote · Europe / Latam · Full Time · Individual Contributor · +5 Years of Experience

Senior Web Developer
Who We Are
Yuno is the AI-native operating system of global commerce, powering the financial infrastructure of enterprise merchants, banks, and wallets. Through a single API, Yuno connects them to pay-ins, payouts, fraud prevention, KYC/KYB, and stablecoins globally, so they can operate everywhere. Agnostic by design and connected to 1,000+ payment methods and 460+ integrations in 190+ countries, Yuno optimizes acceptance rates, reduces costs, and strengthens security through specialized AI agents that learn from every transaction. Global brands including McDonald's, NetEase Games, GoFundMe, and Rappi run their payments on Yuno.

About The Role
Yuno is looking for a Senior Web Developer to build the SDK, design system, and web components that power how third parties integrate with our platform. You'll own the developer-facing surface of Yuno's single API — the reusable components and SDKs that merchants, banks, and partners embed into their own products across browsers, frameworks, and environments.

This is a role where developer experience is the product: the quality, performance, and consistency of what you ship directly shape how easily the world connects to Yuno.

How AI Shows Up in This Role

AI is our default execution layer — you'll use AI-assisted tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot, and LLMs more broadly, across design, implementation, debugging, testing, documentation, and code review as standard practice, not novelty

You'll help shape how the engineering team works with AI, building workflows with AI agents and MCP servers and defining AI-driven development practices that raise the whole team's leverage

The SDKs and components you build are the developer-facing edge of an AI-native payments platform whose agents learn from every transaction on the network



Your Contribution Will Be

SDK and design system — create the design system and web components used across third-party applications, ensuring SDK compatibility across browsers, frameworks, and integration environments

Cross-platform consistency — collaborate with backend and mobile teams so the SDK behaves consistently across every platform and integration

Performance and build optimization — design low-latency, high-availability applications and optimize bundle size, tree-shaking, and build performance for SDK distribution

Full-stack integration — connect user-facing elements with server-side logic and integrate data storage solutions into cohesive, reliable systems

Code quality and security — write reusable, testable, and efficient code, and implement security and data protection throughout

Developer experience and releases — maintain high-quality documentation and DX for integrators, and design automated pipelines for publishing and versioning SDK releases



What Success Looks Like
Within your first 6–12 months, you've shipped SDK components adopted by external integrators, raised the bar on developer experience and documentation, and own the pipeline that publishes and versions Yuno's web SDKs.

Skills You Need
Minimum Qualifications

5+ years building production applications with React, with strong JavaScript and TypeScript

Solid command of the modern web stack — Node, CSS, Next.js, Storybook, and Emotion

Engineering fundamentals — OOP, Git, unit and E2E testing, and CI/CD

Build and packaging tooling (NPM / yarn), with an eye for bundle size and performance

AWS (S3, Amplify) and Docker

AI-assisted development — fluent use of tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot, and leveraging LLMs across design, implementation, debugging, testing, documentation, and code reviews

Autonomy and agile delivery — you own tasks end to end and work comfortably in SCRUM

English — advanced proficiency, written and spoken



Preferred Qualifications

Experience in the payments industry and integrating Payment Service Providers (PSPs)

Backend experience (e.g., NestJS) and familiarity with backend languages

Building custom workflows with AI agents, MCP servers, development assistants, or engineering automation platforms



Nice to Have

Experience defining AI-driven development practices within an engineering team

Spanish proficiency



What We Offer at Yuno

Competitive Compensation

Remote Work — you can work from everywhere

Home Office Bonus — a one-time allowance to set up your ideal home office

Work Equipment

Stock Options

Health Plan wherever you are

Flexible Days Off

Language, Professional, and Personal Growth courses





We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment.
Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
If you would like more information about how your data is processed or wish to exercise your data protection rights, please contact us at hiring@y.uno.

title: Full-stack developer GLASS
originalJobContent:
Wil je deel uitmaken van een Agile productteam dat complexe uitdagingen in het onderwijs aanpakt? Als full-stack developer bij ICT Services van de Universiteit van Amsterdam en Hogeschool van Amsterdam, werk je samen met jouw collega's aan innovatieve oplossingen voor studieplanning, waardoor studenten hun academische traject effectiever kunnen beheren.

Werken bij de UvA

Kom bij ons werken

Als full-stack developer ben je binnen het productteam GLASS verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen van het nieuwe product STUDIEPLAN. Er wordt gebruik gemaakt van .NET in de back-end en React + TypeScript in de front-end, waarbij de communicatie tussen de twee op basis van GraphQL plaatsvindt. Er wordt gebruik gemaakt van de Apollo Client in een omgeving die is gebouwd volgens het CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation) patroon. Als team zijn we verantwoordelijk voor het volledig functioneren van onze oplossingen, en we hanteren het principe 'you build it, you run it'. Ook ben je betrokken bij het ontwerpen en opzetten van geautomatiseerde tests met rapportages.

Een goed salaris Je salaris wordt bepaald op basis van jouw ervaring en senioriteit, conform de CAO Universiteiten. Je inschaling en dus de genoemde bedragen zijn gebaseerd op een volledig dienstverband van 38 uur per week.
232 vakantie-uren Ook bieden we ouderschapsverlof, partnerverlof en verlof wegens maatschappelijke betrokkenheid. Via de Menukaart Arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn er mogelijkheden tot nog meer vakantie-uren.
Financiële regelingen Bovenop je salaris ontvang je vakantiegeld (8%) en een eindejaarsuitkering (8,3%). Je bouwt een goed pensioen op bij het ABP. En daarnaast bieden we nog veel meer tegemoetkomingen en regelingen.
Loopbaanontwikkeling en ruimte voor groei De UvA stimuleert jou om je blijvend te professionaliseren d.m.v. trainingen en open UvA-colleges.
Flexibiliteit Je hebt de flexibiliteit om werk en privé te combineren, vaak met de mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken.

Alles over deze vacature

Dit ga je doen

Denk hierbij aan de volgende werkzaamheden:

De ontwikkeling van het nieuwe STUDIEPLAN-product binnen het GLASS-productteam;
Uitwerken van functionele eisen en technische oplossingen, programmeren van nieuwe systeemdelen, testen, analyseren van testresultaten en foutcorrectie;
Ontwerpen en implementeren van geautomatiseerde tests met bijbehorende rapportages.

Dit vragen we van jou

Wij zoeken een ervaren professional die:

Back-end vereisten:

Ervaring in C# en de nieuwste versies van .NET (minimaal 5 jaar);
Ervaring met verschillende ontwikkeltools, zoals Docker en Git;
Ervaring met Azure, IaC, Kubernetes, Terraform en GitOps;
Ervaring met micro services;
Ervaring met het ontwerpen en bouwen van schaalbare API’s; specifieke ervaring met GraphQL is een sterke pre.

Front-end vereisten:

Ervaring met front-end frameworks; specifieke ervaring met React is een pre;
Ervaring met TypeScript;
Kennis van gebruik van GraphQL API’s met de Apollo client;
Je schrijft graag zelf CSS;
Kennis van module federation voor micro frontends is een pre.

Algemeen profiel:

Bekendheid met agile ontwikkelingsmethodieken;
Professionele beheersing van de Nederlandse taal maar je hoeft geen native speaker te zijn;
Passie voor het vinden van technische oplossingen en het leveren van kwaliteit;
Zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid in het beheer van applicaties en releases;
Ervaring met het opzetten van complexe web applicaties.

Dit bieden we jou nog meer

Een dynamische en creatieve werkomgeving waar je veel ruimte krijgt voor individuele inbreng en waar jouw expertise wordt gewaardeerd!

Deze functie past binnen het functieprofiel IT-IV Engineering and Application Manager 1 of 2. Bij deze functie hoort schaal 11 of 12. Het salaris bedraagt minimaal €4.925,- en maximaal €7.573,- bruto per maand bij een volledig dienstverband (38 uur per week) exclusief vakantiegeld (8%) en eindejaarsuitkering (8,3%) en is afhankelijk van competenties en ervaring. De cao Nederlandse Universiteiten is van toepassing.

De UvA heeft een uitgebreid pakket secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder:

29 vakantiedagen bij een volledig dienstverband & extra vakantiedagen tussen kerst en de jaarwisseling;
Mobiele telefoon en een laptop;
Internet- en thuiswerkvergoeding;
Pensioenopbouw bij het ABP;
Je hebt de flexibiliteit om werk en privé te combineren, met de mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken;
Door wekelijks twee uur meer te werken dan je contracturen, ontvang je op jaarbasis 96 compensatie-uren. Dat geldt ook als je parttimer bent;
Daarnaast biedt de UvA uitstekende studie- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en stimuleert medewerkers om zich blijvend te professionaliseren;
Ook kun je deelnemen aan Open UvA-Colleges om je verder te ontwikkelen en je horizon te verbreden. De UvA vergoedt de kosten hiervoor binnen de daarvoor geldende regeling.

Het betreft een fulltime dienstverband voor 38 uur per week. We bieden een tijdelijke arbeidsovereenkomst voor een jaar met uitzicht op een arbeidsovereenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd. Je standplaats wordt Hogehilweg 21, Amsterdam.

Nieuwsgierig naar onze organisatie en aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een ruime vakantieregeling en ontwikkelmogelijkheden? Hier lees je meer over werken bij de Universiteit van Amsterdam. Voor de HvA, zie medewerkers aan het woord.

Jouw plek bij de UvA

In dit team / bij deze afdeling kom je te werken

De Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA) en de Hogeschool van Amsterdam (HvA) leveren kwalitatief hoogwaardig onderwijs en onderzoek. Zonder ICT zijn de 90.000 studenten en 10.000 medewerkers van de HvA en UvA nergens. Niet voor niets werken er ruim 300 professionals bij de centrale dienst ICT Services (ICTS). Van het leveren van ICT-middelen tot het onderhouden van de technische infrastructuur, en van het ontwikkelen van apps tot gebruikersondersteuning via de servicedesk: ons takenpakket is superbreed. Je kunt dus alle kanten op.

We werken aan complexe technische uitdagingen zoals cloud computing, big data en machine learning. En als het gaat om cybersecurity, dan loopt onze ICT-organisatie landelijk voorop. Wat jouw werk nog meer zo boeiend maakt, is dat je bijdraagt aan onderwijs en onderzoek. Daarin werken we aan de beste combinatie tussen innoveren en kwaliteit. Kortom, je blijft up-to-date en hebt een baan met maatschappelijke impact. Meer lezen

Afdeling Applicatiebeheer, Team GLASS

Welkom bij het GLASS team, waar innovatie en samenwerking samenkomen. In team GLASS krijg je de kans om een significante impact te hebben op de toekomst van onderwijsvoorbereiding en technologische vooruitgang. Ons team is vastberaden om de volgende doelstellingen te verwezenlijken:

Onze uitdaging is het bouwen van het nieuwe en complexe STUDIEPLAN en het tegelijkertijd verbeteren en uitbreiden van de huidige functionaliteit van de GLASS-applicatie;
Studenten ondersteunen bij succesvolle studieplanning en vakaanmelding. Een zorgeloze ervaring van begin tot eind van de studie;
Faculteiten faciliteren op gebied van onderwijsvoorbereiding en ondersteuning bij de uitvoering van het onderwijs;
Wij zijn toegewijd aan het verbeteren van onze ontwikkelprocessen door de implementatie van Continuous Integration en Continuous Delivery. Dit stelt ons in staat om onze softwareontwikkeling sneller en met hogere kwaliteit uit te voeren, wat bijdraagt aan een efficiënte werkomgeving;
Innovatie is een kernwaarde voor ons. We innoveren voortdurend om ervoor te zorgen dat studenten kunnen studeren met behulp van geavanceerde technologieën en processen.

Binnen ons hechte GLASS-team vind je een groep van gedreven professionals. Je werkt zij aan zij met 3 back-end developers, 2 front-end developers, 1 functioneel beheerder, 2 UX/UI Designers, en een product owner. Het team werkt 2 dagen (dinsdagen en donderdagen) op kantoor in Amsterdam-Zuidoost en 3 dagen vanuit huis. We koesteren open communicatie en bevorderen constructieve discussies, omdat we geloven dat dit de basis vormt voor groei en succes. Word lid van ons team en speel een cruciale rol in het vormgeven van de toekomst van onderwijslogistiek en technologische innovatie. Jouw bijdrage zal een blijvende impact hebben op studenten terwijl je samen met ons bouwt aan een betere onderwijservaring.

Voor meer informatie zie onze LinkedIn-pagina Universiteit van Amsterdam: Werken in de ICT en de websites www.hva.nl en www.uva.nl.

Past deze vacature niet bij jouw profiel? We hebben nog meer vacatures!

Kijk hiervoor bij de vacatures van ICTS bij de HvA en de UvA.

Bij de werving en selectie ter invulling van deze vacature houden wij de UvA Sollicitatiecode aan.

Bij ICTS hechten we veel waarde aan integriteit en kwalificaties. Als onderdeel van ons sollicitatieproces voeren wij een controle uit om de betrouwbaarheid en geschiktheid van onze kandidaten te waarborgen door een identiteitscontrole en diploma- en referentiechecks.

Meer over de UvA

De Universiteit van Amsterdam is ambitieus, creatief en betrokken. Sinds 1632 een inspiratie voor studenten, een voorhoedespeler in de internationale wetenschap en een partner in vernieuwing.

De Universiteit van Amsterdam is de grootste universiteit van Nederland, met het breedste opleidingsaanbod. Een intellectueel knooppunt met 44.000 studenten, 6.000 medewerkers en 3.000 promovendi. Verbonden door een cultuur van nieuwsgierigheid.

Belangrijk om te weten

Jouw sollicitatie & contact

Is dit de baan voor jou en word jij onze nieuwe collega? Wij zijn benieuwd naar jou!

Klik bovenin op deze pagina op de knop “solliciteer” om direct te solliciteren.

Wil je eerst nog even verder praten over jouw misschien wel toekomstige werkzaamheden? Neem dan contact op met:

Joshua Bonsink, Solution Architect, via j.c.bonsink@uva.nl.

(Gebruik dit emailadres uitsluitend voor het stellen van vragen; we verwerken alleen sollicitaties die we ontvangen via de sollicitatieknop onderaan deze vacature).

Heb je nog vragen over je sollicitatie of het proces? Neem dan gerust contact op met:

Jacqueline Bet, Recruiter ICTS, via 06-14365658 of per e-mail j.bet@uva.nl.

Ook belangrijk!

Bij gelijke geschiktheid krijgen interne kandidaten voorrang.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Daar gaan we niet op in.

Als werkgever hanteert de UvA een beleid van gelijke kansen. We vinden diversiteit belangrijk en zetten ons volledig in om een plek te zijn waar iedereen zich thuis voelt. We koesteren de onderzoekende geest en het doorzettingsvermogen en laten ruimte om door te vragen. Bij ons vormen nieuwsgierigheid en creativiteit de heersende cultuur.

Let op! Voor deze vacature communiceren wij een (uiterste) sluitingsdatum. Echter, bij de ontvangst van passende of aansluitende sollicitaties zullen er al vóór de sluitingsdatum sollicitatiegesprekken plaatsvinden. Bij gebleken geschiktheid kan dit eventueel betekenen dat de vacature vervuld wordt vóór het verstrijken van de gecommuniceerde uiterste sluitingsdatum.

Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

Diversiteit en inclusie

Als werkgever handhaaft de UvA een beleid van gelijke kansen. We vinden diversiteit belangrijk en zetten ons volledig in om een plek te zijn waar iedereen zich thuis voelt. We koesteren de onderzoekende geest en het doorzettingsvermogen en laten de ruimte om door te vragen. Bij ons vormen nieuwsgierigheid en creativiteit de heersende cultuur.

Studies tonen aan dat vrouwen en leden van ondervertegenwoordigde groepen alleen solliciteren naar banen als ze aan 100% van de kwalificaties voldoen. Voldoe jij wel aan de opleidingseisen maar heb je nog niet alle gevraagde ervaring? Dan moedigt de UvA je aan om toch te solliciteren.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
originalJobContent:
About Fidamy

Fidamy is redefining insurance by seamlessly embedding innovative, non-life insurance products into our partners' digital and physical customer journeys. We empower our partners to unlock new revenue streams and build lasting customer loyalty.

Our engineering team is the backbone of this mission. We design and maintain the modern infrastructure that powers embedded insurance at scale, enabling our partners to deliver insurance effortlessly through clean, reliable integrations.

We're tackling complex technical challenges in a regulated, data-intensive landscape long dominated by legacy systems—a huge opportunity for transformation. Making insurance integration fast, secure, and developer-friendly can unlock an enormous market.

Our goal: replace fragile insurance tech with robust, scalable software. We build production systems where correctness, security, and performance are essential, not optional.

Backed by NN Ventures, we operate as a small, high-trust engineering team. Every engineer helps shape architecture and product decisions and contributes software built to stand the test of time.

Why Now?

Embedded insurance is expected to grow from 1% to 16% of global insurance spending by 2032—a $3 trillion opportunity. Fidamy is poised to play a leading role as the market transforms.

We're moving rapidly and scaling fast. We're looking for a sharp, hands-on Senior Platform Engineer to help drive our technology forward. If you want a high-impact, entrepreneurial role at a fast-growing startup, this is your moment.

What You'll Do

Build and own the reliability and scalability of our production systems, cloud infrastructure, and codebase, ensuring the platform securely manages sensitive financial and personal data.
Lead backup and disaster recovery across the platform: define clear recovery targets, rehearse and validate restores, and provide evidence of resilience.
Be the first responder when platform incidents arise—whether they’re infrastructure issues, pipeline failures, or security events—and lead the follow-up to prevent recurrence.
Share responsibility for our Infrastructure as Code: review and author changes, and keep our infrastructure safe to evolve.
Maintain and enhance deployment tooling (TypeScript, with tests) for continuous, safe releases to production.
Consistently strengthen the platform security baseline with ongoing improvements such as edge protection, audit logging, pipeline scanning, and secret rotation.
Own and develop our authorisation model, ensuring every operation passes robust, externalised permission checks for both people and AI agents.
Use AI-driven development as standard: direct coding agents, specify and test requirements, and rigorously review results.
Influence the technical roadmap, participate in design reviews, and set a high standard for engineering quality across the team.

Tech Stack

AI-driven development: Claude Code and coding agents as standard tooling
Ways of working: test-driven development, for the deployment tooling as much as for the applications; infrastructure changes reviewed and applied through the pipeline; shipped continuously
Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform
Data stores: PostgreSQL, S3, NoSQL
Application: React, Vite, Tailwind, Node.js (TypeScript), Python
Observability: OpenTelemetry, with managed tracing and alerting on top
Data & AI: Databricks, AWS Bedrock

Our Culture

Move the Needle: Build systems that create tangible impact for partners and customers.
Master Your Craft: Prioritise deep work, continuous learning, and knowledge sharing.
Customer Obsession: Work directly with partners to solve technical challenges.
Be Different: Challenge industry norms while maintaining enterprise-grade reliability.
Thrive Together: Innovate quickly and execute thoughtfully in a collaborative setting.

What We're Looking For

Robust, hands-on AWS expertise and fluency with Terraform, a non-negotiable requirement. You can review and improve existing cloud estates thoroughly.
Experience running real-world restores in production and setting clear recovery targets. Reliability, SLOs, and incident response are central to your approach.
Experience designing robust permission models and working with extrinsic (outside the app) authorization systems.
Proficiency in a modern programming language (TypeScript, Python, or Go) and willingness to work in TypeScript for deployment and authorization tooling.
Familiarity with AI-driven software development: comfortable orchestrating coding agents and using specifications/tests as their interface.
Proven record of owning outcomes end-to-end (not just completing tickets), with evidence to back it up.
Excellent instincts for security within regulated environments dealing with money and personal data. Insurance/Insurtech experience is a plus but not required.
Proactive, pragmatic, and communicative; you’re a problem-solver and team contributor in a small, agile environment.
Ability to travel to the Amsterdam office at least two days per week.

Why Join Us?

Competitive compensation
Latest MacBook Pro and equipment
Paid licences for Claude Code, AI agents, and leading development tools
Flexible hybrid work (2–3 days in the office)
Visa sponsorship available (including takeover of an existing Dutch visa; no relocation support)
Beautiful Amsterdam office
High ownership and direct influence on architecture and product
Opportunity for fast-track career growth

title: Senior Product Engineer - Payments Team
originalJobContent:
Hi! 👋 I'm Ismayil, Engineering Manager for Team Payments at WeTravel.

I joined WeTravel to help simplify how group travel businesses handle payments and bookings. Having worked across various tech roles from startups to universities, I'm passionate about building reliable systems that solve real operational challenges. Our Payments team ensures that thousands of travel organizers can collect payments, manage installment plans, and pay suppliers seamlessly every month. We process 150K+ payments each month! As we expand our payment capabilities with localized payment methods and language support for new markets, I'm looking for engineers who are excited about making complex financial transactions feel simple for our global users.

About WeTravel

Think of the most incredible adventures imaginable: trekking to Machu Picchu, cycling through Tuscany, or going on a safari in Kenya. For years, the small businesses and local experts who run these trips have been stuck using messy spreadsheets, countless emails, and complicated payment methods.

WeTravel is changing that. We build the tools that empower any entrepreneur to launch and grow their own travel business. Our platform makes it simple for organizers to create beautiful trip proposals, securely process payments, and manage their customers, so they can focus on what they do best: creating amazing experiences.

This is one of the last great frontiers of travel to come online, and as the category leader, we are at the forefront of this change. Last year alone, our platform was trusted by 8,000 organizers to lead over a million travelers on adventures in 150+ countries. Now, we’re on an exciting journey to grow from powering $1B to $10B in travel experiences per year.

We believe that every trip, when done right, can be a force for good - and we’re building the engine to make more of that possible.

What’s The Role

You will join the Payments team to lead critical projects across collection, disbursement, FX, reconciliation, and a new card issuing stack. Upcoming work includes:

New payment method expansion: doubling our payment methods next 12 months, with focus on local digital methods (UPI, PIX, account-to-account rails) in priority markets.
Card issuing: building a card issuing capability in dozens of geographies, including the ledger, authorization flows, controls, and operational tooling around it.
Reliability and structural improvements: scaling our payment processing capability to reach 10x growth.
Multi-currency and FX: Broadening our conversion engine and global reach across more than 20 currencies.

What You’ll Do Day-to-day

Lead payments projects end-to-end: discovery with Product and PayOps teams, integration design with PSPs, build, rollout, monitoring, and incident response.
Partner with the Product team to gain insight into organizer and traveler challenges, building payment solutions that successfully process transactions.
Own the reliability of our payments system
Contribute to WeTravel’s engineering practices and excellence.

How We Work

We’re focused on the impact. We don’t subscribe to any one framework or execution ideology, and we adapt based on what’s impactful.
We’re using the latest hardware and constantly on the look out for better tools & ways to work.
We have AI-first development experience and work with the latest models and agentic dev tools.
Stack: We’re developing React/TypeScript, Ruby on Rails and Kotlin Microservices. Our services run on Kubernetes. We also use and love MongoDB, MySQL, Postgres, Snowflake and we’re working with the major LLM providers.

Basic Qualifications

You should apply if you have:

7+ years of product engineering expertise, with 4+ years dedicated to architecting complex payments systems.
Proven track record within a PSP, acquirer, gateway, or a high-scale platform payments team.
Broad practical expertise in deploying and troubleshooting production-level integrations across various PSPs, card acquirer ecosystems, and diverse payment rails. You possess deeply ingrained expertise in settlement processes, reconciliation, dispute management, 3DS2 protocols, high-pressure webhook management, and PCI compliance frameworks, including tokenization methods.
Strong backend mastery in Ruby on Rails, Kotlin, Python, Go, Java, or Node.js with the agility to ramp up on Ruby quickly.
Full-stack comfort: you can build the React interface for the payment flows you architect.
Deep expertise in architecting robust, resilient distributed systems, including double-entry ledgers, automated reconciliation pipelines, money movement state machines, idempotency, exactly-once semantics, event-driven architectures, webhooks, and reliable consumer patterns.
Direct production on-call experience, including authoring post-mortems and leading incident response.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including cross-functional collaboration experience, and the ability to thrive in a distributed, multicultural environment.
Pragmatic adoption of AI tools to optimize your engineering workflow, including the ability to mentor and train others on AI concepts.

Technical Skills

Strong background in cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), containerization, and modern CI/CD practices.
Experience in handling critical systems with precision: you will handle FX and multi-currency logic directly within the application layer.
Bonus: Direct card issuing experience, including BIN sponsorship, processor integrations, controls, and dispute handling.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience launching a new payment method or PSP integration end-to-end.
Experience building or operating a card issuing program.
Experience in marketplace or two-sided platform payments (split payments, payouts, escrow-like flows).

You Might Not Be The Right Fit If You

Your payments expertise is limited to high-level integrations like Stripe Checkout. We need someone who operates deeply beneath that abstraction layer.
You are hesitant to take full ownership of mission-critical money movement or participate in the on-call rotation when systems fail.
You prioritize greenfield development over the complex challenge of scaling and refining an existing system with significant transaction volume.
You are looking for a siloed IC position without the need for cross-functional collaboration or product-level discovery.
You require a rigid, pre-defined roadmap; we prefer to sharpen our strategy and direction as we scale the team.

Why join us?

Solve real payments problems at real volume: billions of dollars of transaction volume, 21 currencies, 14 integrations and growing.
Make a real impact: you’ll help build the operating system for the multi-day group travel industry, empowering thousands of organizers and millions of travelers worldwide.
Solve meaningful technical challenges at scale, from designing robust systems to improving real-time user experiences in a complex domain.
Be part of building the best engineering team: you’ll help shape culture, mentor others, and contribute to high standards of excellence and collaboration.
Enjoy flexibility and balance, with competitive compensation, generous PTO, and remote-friendly work culture.

Benefits Section

Competitive salary
Generous "Time to Recharge" policy - enjoy unlimited paid time off to rest, recharge, and show up as your best self.
Our Work From Anywhere perk provides eligible employees with up to four weeks per calendar year to work temporarily from another approved location.
2-week cross-functional onboarding program.
Annual team off-site (often somewhere sunny 🌊).
Cycle-to-work scheme (Swapfiets subscription) or commuting reimbursement.
Monday/Thursday team lunches and after-work social events.
Extensive paid family leave.
Three paid volunteer days per year - take time to give back to causes you care about, on us.
Cutting-edge equipment and tools to set you up for success.
Join an international, travel-loving team with a passion for adventure and innovation.

Equal Opportunities

WeTravel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you're excited about this opportunity and believe you're a good fit, we encourage you to apply and join us in transforming the travel industry!

Location

Our Full Stack Software Engineer will be an integral part of our R&D team. This role is based remotely as a full-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal.

Who We Are

DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity

Cloud spend is no longer just AWS, Google Cloud and Azure. Our customers now run a large and growing share of their technology spend through SaaS platforms, data clouds and AI vendors - and every one of those vendors is an integration that brings another slice of their spend into view.

You'll own DoiT's Integrations Framework and the experience built on top of it. This is a chance to define what a great integration experience looks like: a customer connects a new vendor in minutes, sees at a glance that their data is flowing, and handles credential rotation, reconnects and backfills themselves without thinking twice. On the framework side, you'll make adding the next vendor a small, well-understood piece of work rather than a project - so coverage grows as fast as the vendor landscape does.

You'll work AI-augmented from day one. Integration development is spec-driven work against constantly changing third-party APIs: one of the highest-leverage places to apply agentic AI tooling. We expect you to use it across your whole workflow and to have real opinions about where it earns its place.

Responsibilities

Building new integrations. This is the core of the role. Design and ship integrations against third-party billing and usage APIs - authentication, incremental sync, rate limits, error handling, schema drift - and invest in the Integrations Framework itself, along with testing harnesses and scaffolding, so the tenth integration takes a fraction of the effort of the first.
Working AI-augmented. Use AI daily across the full span of your work - exploring unfamiliar codebases and third-party APIs, prototyping approaches, generating and reviewing code, debugging, writing tests, and producing documentation. Push on what agentic tooling can do for this codebase, and bring judgement about where AI raises velocity and where a human still has to hold the quality bar.
Integration management experience. Build the interfaces customers use to connect, configure and trust their integrations: health and status visibility, actionable error states, credential and key rotation, and clear feedback when something needs attention.
Self-service by default. Design self-service into the framework from the start - backfills, reconnects and diagnostics that customers and internal teams run themselves.
API-first. Build capabilities so they're fully available through APIs, not just the UI. Both humans and agents should be able to drive the platform.
Implementing features end-to-end. From proposal, through spec and implementation, to maintenance. You're expected to propose things you think would be a good addition, not wait for a spec.

Qualifications

3+ years of professional software engineering experience, shipping and owning features in production
Strong TypeScript, including modern frontend work - React preferred
Hands-on experience with Go, or strong backend experience in another language (Python, Java, Node.js, C#) with genuine enthusiasm for ramping up in Go quickly
Real experience designing and consuming REST APIs, and integrating third-party APIs with all the mess that entails: auth flows, pagination, rate limits, partial failures, breaking changes
Comfortable across the stack. You may lean backend or lean frontend, but you can own a feature from the database through to the interface
Working proficiency in SQL
Experience developing solutions in the cloud and/or using cloud services (GCP, AWS or Azure)
A user-facing instinct for operational tooling - you care whether the error message actually tells someone what to do next
AI-augmented working style - you already use AI tools across your engineering workflow and can talk concretely about what you've got out of them
Strong knowledge of software engineering practices, design patterns and architectural principles
Demonstrated passion for creating high-quality web/SaaS apps
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal
Self-organized, goal-oriented and self-motivated; confident, thorough and tenacious

Bonus Points

Experience building integration platforms or extensibility frameworks as a core part of a product
Experience with cloud or SaaS billing data - AWS/GCP/Azure cost and usage exports, AI vendor billing data, marketplace billing, or the FOCUS specification
Experience with Google BigQuery, or with data pipelines and orchestration tooling (Dagster, Airflow)
Experience building AI-powered product features (LLM integration, intelligent automation)
Exposure to FinOps practices or cloud financial management products
BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience

Are you a Do'er?

Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.

We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button.

Full-time employee benefits include:

Unlimited Vacation
Flexible Working Options
Health Insurance
Parental Leave
Employee Stock Option Plan
Home Office Allowance
Professional Development Stipend
Peer Recognition Program

Many Do'ers, One Team

DoiT unites as Many Do'ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal-it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

What we do-
Circle B builds sustainable IT infrastructure for the AI and cloud era. For over a decade— we have designed and deployed datacenter, edge, and AI/HPC systems on Open Compute Project (OCP) hardware. We are independent, vendor-neutral, and ISO 9001 / 14001 / 27001 certified, with deployments across multiple countries.
Our newest initiative is a sovereign EU GPU cloud — operating under full Dutch/EU jurisdiction and beyond the reach of the US CLOUD Act, for regulated European organizations that cannot compromise on where their data lives.

The Role-
You own everything above the cluster: the observability platform, the GPU metering-to-billing pipeline, the operation of the AI service catalogue, and the SLOs that define reliability. Your job is to make the GPU clusters delivered to you observable, measurable, billable, and reliable.

What you will own-

Observability & Reliability
Build and operate the full observability stack: metrics (Prometheus + long-term store such as VictoriaMetrics/Thanos), logs (Loki + a forwarder), and alerting (Alertmanager)
Integrate DCGM GPU telemetry into the pipeline: utilisation, memory, temperature, power, SM activity — per GPU, per tenant
Surface GPU and fabric health (DCGM XID errors, NCCL/RDMA, RoCE/link health) from the Infra and Network engineers into a single pane — you own dashboards, alerting, and tenant-impact SLOs; Infra/Network own the fabric remediation
Build the dashboarding capability (Grafana with SSO), ready for tenants at launch
Define SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets; implement burn-rate alerting
Implement OpenTelemetry instrumentation across platform services; lay the alerting and runbook foundations for reliable operation later
Metering, Billing & Service Delivery
Build the GPU metering pipeline: DCGM + scheduler/namespace state → accurate per-tenant usage events (GPU-hours per tenant) with idempotency and reconciliation → a usage-based billing engine, billing primarily on allocated/reserved GPU-time
Deploy cost-attribution (OpenCost or equivalent) for per-tenant GPU and infrastructure showback/chargeback
Integrate a billing engine (Lago, Stripe Billing, or Metronome): flat fee + storage/egress overages, SEPA B2B direct debit
Deploy and operate the AI service catalogue — model-serving runtimes (KServe / NVIDIA NIM Operator, Triton, vLLM), notebooks (JupyterHub), experiment tracking (MLflow), a vector DB (Qdrant), and a distributed-job framework (Ray/KubeRay) — as repeatable, GitOps-driven templates. Operation, not model authoring
Operate the air-gapped registry and controlled artifact seeding into the sovereign zone (with Network on the path policy)
Expose platform APIs (gateway, rate limiting, integration glue) for the future customer portal
Build the tenant onboarding/offboarding automation — the path from a new tenant to running GPU workloads, end to end

What We Are Looking For-

Required Skills-
5+ years in platform engineering / SRE, deploying and operating complex service stacks on K8s (operators, CRDs, Helm, scheduling, multi-tenancy / quota)
Go and/or Python to a software-engineering standard — control-plane services and automation, not just scripting
Production observability end-to-end: Prometheus + a long-term store (VictoriaMetrics / Thanos / Mimir), Grafana, Alertmanager, Loki, OpenTelemetry; designing SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets
GPU observability: running the DCGM exporter and surfacing GPU/fabric health (XID, NCCL, RoCE) into dashboards and alerts (surface, not fabric-remediate)
Ability to build a GPU metering pipeline: DCGM + scheduler/namespace state → accurate, idempotent per-tenant usage events → a billing engine
Deploy and operate (not author) model-serving + ML-platform services on K8s: KServe and/or NIM/Triton/vLLM, plus Ray, JupyterHub, MLflow, Harbor, a vector DB
Infrastructure-as-Code + GitOps: Helm, Kustomize, and ArgoCD or Flux in production
Strong Linux fundamentals and production troubleshooting (systemd, container runtimes, REST/gRPC APIs, event-driven pipelines)
Self-driven and comfortable with the breadth of a pre-launch platform: context-switching across observability, metering, service delivery, and onboarding

Preferred Skills-
Prior hands-on with a commercial / OSS usage-based billing engine (Lago, OpenMeter, Metronome, Stripe Billing, Amberflo) and event-driven metering; EU payment integration (SEPA, Mollie, or Stripe EU) a plus
NVIDIA AI Enterprise / NIM Operator; Run:ai or KAI Scheduler for GPU quota, fair-share, and multi-tenancy
OpenCost / FinOps: GPU cost allocation, chargeback / showback
Container registry operations in air-gapped environments (Harbor, Quay, or similar)
Identity & access integration (OIDC/SAML, SSO, tenant-scoped RBAC) and API gateways (Kong, Envoy, Traefik)
EU regulatory awareness: GDPR, AI Act, DORA, NIS2, NEN 7510 in a platform context
TypeScript (billing/admin tooling; interfacing with the future Fullstack portal)

Nice to Have
Event streaming for telemetry / metering
Experience operating a Kubernetes-native multi-cluster management platform
Experience at an AI neocloud, GPU cloud provider, or managed ML platform
Familiarity with NCCL / RDMA fabric troubleshooting

Why Join Us
Help build a sovereign EU GPU cloud from the ground up.
Own a critical platform layer, not just tickets or maintenance.
Work on modern AI infrastructure, GPU platforms, Kubernetes, observability, and automation.
Join a company with deep experience in OCP, datacenter, AI/HPC, and cloud infrastructure.

Pension scheme.
Visa sponsorship.
Company gym.
Modern office in Hoofddorp.
Informal and open working culture.
Participation in relevant conferences and exhibitions across Europe.
Opportunity to develop your skills in a fast-growing technology environment.

Our Work Culture
Circle B offers an informal working atmosphere with energetic people who enjoy being part of a growing technology company. We have an open management culture and encourage colleagues to contribute to improving our products, services, and processes.

About Gigs

At Gigs, we're building the operating system for mobile services—a platform that lets tech companies embed global connectivity into their products effortlessly.

Just as Stripe lets any business add a payment button in seconds, Gigs empowers platforms to weave in connectivity—bridging the traditional world of telecom with modern tech. From fintechs launching mobile services to HR platforms offering work phone plans, we automate provisioning and remove telecom complexity.

Our team of around 150 people across the US and Europe, backed by nearly $100 million in funding from Ribbit Capital, Google, and Y Combinator. As one of the fastest-growing tech companies, bringing together early-stage engineers, product builders, and business athletes from companies like Stripe, Airbnb, and Shopify. We’re tackling deep technical and regulatory challenges to make connectivity truly seamless.

If you’re driven by curiosity, creativity, and the chance to shape the future of telecom, we’d love to hear from you.

Things We Care About

We are building in a highly complex space and tackling a massive problem. We want people who lean in when things get hard.

Speed. We move and we ship. We set bold deadlines and treat every week like it matters.
Ownership. If you see something broken, fix it. We don't wait for permission.
Customer Obsession. Our customers' product is our product.
Ambiguity. We're building frontier technology in a complex domain. You'll need sound judgement and good instincts to make decisions without complete information.
First principles. We don't ask how things have been done before. We ask why they were done that way at all.

The Role

You will help build Connect, our consumer-facing hosted checkout and subscription management service, and related projects to deliver the best experience for our customers and their users.
You will bring new ideas to directly shape our app development and products beyond our established work.
You will work with a modern tech stack using Next.js, React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.
You will use your skills for Frontend and Backend technologies built on top of Next.js.
You will take ownership of features from planning and implementing to shipping and optimizing.
You will work closely with our UI/UX team to develop the best possible experiences for our users.
You will help design maintainable and scalable software architectures.
You will give feedback, ideas, and code reviews to your colleagues.
You will collaborate with colleagues across the engineering organization through cross-functional working groups and our RFC process.

Salary range:

EU: €105,000 - 125,000
UK: £105,000 - 125,000

(The final offer depends on your background, skills, and how you perform through the process. We're open to considering outlier candidates, which may result in an adjustment to the scope and compensation)

What We Are Looking For

You have advanced experience building web apps using React. You are a TypeScript pro, know your way around Next.js, and can implement common and advanced React patterns. You’ve been doing this for 5+ years. Working with git is natural for you.
You enjoy building best-in-class experiences. You know what makes apps excellent, you can give your input and are able to implement the best possible UX.
You have built and maintained scalable apps. You love to build things for scale and have experience in designing app architectures and writing high-quality code.
You enjoy building a product from scratch. This means high involvement in the design process and understanding what customers want and users need.
You love learning technologies as you go. You always want to find the right tool for the job, and not only follow what you already know.
You care about more than engineering quality. Whatever you do, needs to have a business impact. You can make trade-offs between speed and quality.
You are an all-rounder: You're fluent with RESTful APIs, worked with Docker, GCP, GitHub Actions, Cypress, or Testing Library, and have some experience with Ruby on Rails.

Work At Gigs

At Gigs, we value in-person collaboration. We believe the best ideas, decisions, and relationships are built when teams spend meaningful time together, and our culture is designed around that belief. We support flexibility where it makes sense. Some focused work can be done remotely, and not every role or week looks the same. You should expect regular time in one of our hubs, as well as occasional travel for team workshops, customer meetings, and Gigs Republic, our bi-annual company off-site. Our offices are designed to feel like home-inspired workspaces, with plants, thoughtful tools, and small, tight-knit teams that make collaboration feel natural, energizing, and effective.

What We Offer

At Gigs, we believe in rewarding excellence. We offer competitive compensation and stock options because we see you as a true partner in our growth. We also provide stipends for your home office or work setup, a budget for learning and development to fuel your career, and of course, a free phone and international data plan

Want to learn more about our benefits, hubs, and what it’s like to work at Gigs? Check out our Careers page.

originalJobContent:
Bedrijfsomschrijving

Een mooie toekomst voor iedereen—dat is waar we bij Sopra Steria naartoe werken.

Met meer dan 51.000 collega’s in bijna 30 landen zijn we één van de grootste leveranciers van digital solutions in Europa. We geloven dat niet enkel technologie transformatie aandrijft.

Maar dat mensen de kern van verandering vormen. Daarom staan mensen ook centraal in alles wat we doen en kun je bij ons zowel individueel als in een team uitblinken.

The world is how we shape it. Let’s shape it together.

Vacatureomschrijving

Wie zijn wij?

Wij zijn de practice JSRoots van Sopra Steria en wij bieden grote organisaties en semi-overheden op maat gemaakte, end-to-end softwareoplossingen. Hiermee helpen we klanten de juiste keuzes te maken en mooie resultaten te behalen. Hierin boeken we al jaren succes na succes!

Wij geloven in de impact van teams bij onze klanten en het overgrote deel van onze diensten betreffen een multidisciplinair team van ontwikkelaars die een band opbouwen en samen de uitdagingen van de klant aangaan met training en ondersteuning vanuit Sopra Steria.

We werken veel met de Nederlandse overheid, de vervoersector, banken en de Nederlandse Politie. Onze opdrachten variëren van grote webapplicaties tot korte pilotprojecten.

Functie-eisen

Als Senior Frontend developer bij JSRoots kan een opdracht het volgende inhouden:

Een bestaande monolithische frontend-applicatie herschrijven naar een moderne microfrontend architectuur.
Optimaliseren van de laadtijd en prestaties van een complexe Single Page Application (SPA).
Implementeren van een Design System met componenten in React, Vue of Angular.
Migreren van een legacy UI naar een moderne stack met bijvoorbeeld React en TypeScript.
Het opzetten van een frontend CI/CD pipeline met tools zoals Vite, Webpack, Jest en Cypress.
Integreren van een Progressive Web App (PWA) om offline functionaliteiten te ondersteunen.
Adviseren over UX/UI-optimalisaties en toegankelijkheid (WCAG) binnen de organisatie.
Werken met API’s en state management oplossingen zoals Redux, Vuex of Recoil.

Krijg je ideeën hoe je dit verder kunt oppakken of jeuken je handen om hieraan te werken? Lees dan vooral verder!

Wat zijn jouw kwalificaties?

Als senior frontend developer verwachten we dat je:

Minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring hebt in frontend-ontwikkeling
Ervaring hebt met moderne JavaScript-frameworks zoals React, Vue of Angular
Ervaring hebt met TypeScript en component-based development
Kennis hebt van CSS-in-JS, Styled Components, Tailwind CSS of andere moderne stylingoplossingen
Ervaring hebt met testmethodieken (unit, integratie, end-to-end testing) en tools zoals Jest, Testing Library of Cypress
Bekend bent met CI/CD-pipelines en DevOps-principes voor frontend-ontwikkeling
Ervaring hebt met werken in een agile scrum omgeving
Bijdraagt aan software-architectuur en technisch ontwerp
Graag werkzaam bent in teamverband
Een positieve mindset en oplossingsgerichte houding meebrengt
In staat bent om kennis en ervaring met plezier over te dragen
Een Bachelor in Informatica of een relevante gelijkwaardige opleiding hebt
Ten minste Nederlands op B1/B2 niveau spreekt

Klinkt dit nog steeds bekend? Dan ben jij de developer die we zoeken, aarzel niet en solliciteer!

Aanvullende informatie

Dit krijg je van ons

Bij Sopra Steria zorgen we ervoor dat jij je werk met plezier én in balans kunt doen. Daarom bieden

we een aantrekkelijk en flexibel pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden:

Een vast contract en een salaris tussen de €4.500,- en €6.500,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40

uur per week). De exacte inschaling hangt af van jouw ervaring en de rol;

Vakantiegeld van 8%;
Een royaal mobiliteitsbudget in de vorm van een leaseregeling van €1.022- 1.209 met de keuze uit een

elektrische leaseauto met NS Business Card of leasefiets of een alternatief vervoersregeling van

€930 - 1.113,- net wat het beste bij jouw manier van reizen past;

Winstdeling van 8% on target (of OTB vast bedrag, afhankelijk van de functie);
27 betaalde vakantiedagen;
Flex Benefits budget van € 1.800, - per jaar.

Dit budget kan worden gebruikt voor zaken als aankoop van extra vrije dagen of extra sparen in jouw

pensioenregeling;

Thuiskantoor met laptop, telefoon en een maandelijkse internetvergoeding;
Hybride werken: thuis of op kantoor, afhankelijk van wat jij nodig hebt;
Ontwikkelmogelijkheden via trainingen, kennisdelingssessies en inspirerende (netwerk)events;
Sociale activiteiten met collega’s – van gezellige borrels tot sportieve of inhoudelijke uitjes;
Een flexibele pensioenregeling, waaraan jij op maat en passend bij jou, bijdragen kan toevoegen.
Je kunt deelnemen aan de collectieve zorgverzekering.

Lijkt deze job iets voor jou?

Ben je klaar om met ons de wereld vorm te geven? Fantastisch! We kijken nu al uit naar jouw sollicitatie!

______

Sopra Steria is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in aanmerking genomen voor een job zonder rekening te houden met leeftijd, afkomst, nationaliteit, huidskleur, verlof voor familie- of medische zorg, geslachtsidentiteit of -uitdrukking, genetische informatie, immigratiestatus, burgerlijke staat, medische toestand, nationale herkomst, fysieke of mentale handicap, politieke voorkeur, beschermde veteranen- of militaire status, ras, etniciteit, religie, geslacht (inclusief zwangerschap), seksuele geaardheid of enig ander kenmerk dat wordt beschermd door toepasselijke lokale wetten, voorschriften en verordeningen. We koesteren een werkomgeving die inclusief is en alle verschillen respecteert.

originalJobContent:
CUBE are a global RegTech business defining and implementing the gold standard of regulatory intelligence for the financial services industry. We deliver our services through intuitive SaaS solutions, powered by AI, to simplify the complex and everchanging world of compliance for our clients.

Why us?

🌍 CUBE is a globally recognized brand at the forefront of Regulatory Technology. Our industry-leading SaaS solutions are trusted by the world’s top financial institutions globally.

🚀 In 2024, we achieved over 50% growth, both organically and through two strategic acquisitions. We’re a fast-paced, high-performing team that thrives on pushing boundaries—continuously evolving our products, services, and operations. At CUBE, we don’t just keep up we stay ahead.

🌱 We believe our future is built by bold, ambitious individuals who are driven to make a real difference. Our “make it happen” culture empowers you to take ownership of your career and accelerate your personal and professional development from day one.

🌐 With over 700 CUBERs across 19 countries spanning EMEA, the Americas, and APAC, we operate as one team with a shared mission to transform regulatory compliance. Diversity, collaboration, and purpose are the heartbeat of our success.

💡 We were among the first to harness the power of AI in regulatory intelligence, and we continue to lead with our cutting-edge technology. At CUBE, You will work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI research and engineering in developing impactful solutions that are reshaping the world of regulatory compliance.

Role Mission

We are looking for a talented Frontend Engineer to join our new Berlin AI lab.

In this role, you will build and maintain clean, scalable web applications, such as intuitive AI Agent interfaces that seamlessly integrate into our broader enterprise system. Because we are a small, agile team, you will have ownership of your work; you are highly encouraged to actively participate in UI/UX and product decision-making.

You will work closely within a tight-knit product squad alongside another frontend engineer and a PM/Designer. You will report to the Head of Agentic AI Engineering while collaborating across a compact, cross-functional team of backend and AI engineers.

Responsibilities

Build, maintain, and scale frontend applications and services using React and TypeScript.
Develop reliable integrations between our frontend, backend APIs, and AI systems.
Work with modern state management like Jotai and component libraries like Mantine to build responsive interfaces.
Help implement and maintain clean, component-based frontend architecture.
Collaborate closely with AI engineers to integrate and productionize AI-powered product features.
Contribute to pragmatic engineering decisions around performance, accessibility, responsiveness, and user experience.

Our Evolving Tech Stack

Core: React, TypeScript, Jotai, Mantine, Playwright
Ecosystem: Claude Code, GitHub, REST APIs

We deeply value being an AI-native team. Embracing tools like Claude Code is an encouraged part of our daily engineering workflow.

Requirements

Strong practical experience building real-world React and TypeScript applications through work, internships, freelancing, open-source contributions, or personal projects.
Understanding of component-based frontend architecture and modern React development patterns
Experience working with RESTful APIs and asynchronous data flows
An eye for good design and an intuition for user-friendly UX
Experience writing automated tests and an interest in maintainable, testable code
Proficiency with Git and modern collaborative development workflows
Strong English communication skills and comfort working in a small, startup-like, tech-driven team

We encourage talented graduates and early-career engineers to apply even if they don’t meet every requirement.

Bonus Points

Familiarity with FastAPI, MySQL, and recent AI developments
Experience with micro-frontends and web component structures
Experience applying or migrating a new design system within an existing production codebase
Experience building B2B SaaS or AI workflow products
Experience in FinTech, RegTech, Finance, Regulatory, or Compliance domains

Interested?

If you are passionate about leveraging technology to transform regulatory compliance and meet the qualifications outlined above, we invite you to apply. Please submit your resume detailing your relevant experience and interest in CUBE.

CUBE is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Für unsere Mission brauchen wir tatkräftige Pioniere mit Teamgeist, Kompetenz und Weitsicht. CAIGOS entwirft und entwickelt Geografische Informationssysteme (GIS) sowie Software-Lösungen für den Netz- und Anlagenbetrieb in der Energie- und Wasserwirtschaft (Asset Management).

Deine Aufgaben

Als Frontend-Entwickler (m/w/d) mit Schwerpunkt React arbeitest du in einem agil organisierten Team an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Web-Frontend-Lösungen im Umfeld unserer CAIGOS-GIS-Produkte. Du begleitest den gesamten Entwicklungsprozess – von der fachlichen Anforderung bis zur Qualitätssicherung. Zu deinen Aufgaben zählen unter anderem:

Entwicklung, Weiterentwicklung und Wartung moderner Web-Frontend-Anwendungen (auf Basis von React und TypeScript) inklusive Konzeption und Umsetzung benutzerfreundlicher Oberflächen
Analyse fachlicher Anforderungen sowie deren Übersetzung in skalierbare Frontend-Konzepte und -Architekturen, inklusive Mitgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung wiederverwendbarer UI-Komponenten
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Backend-Entwicklung zur Anbindung und Nutzung von REST-APIs und weiteren Schnittstellen
Integration und Pflege von Schnittstellen und Datenformaten (z. B. REST/JSON, optional Protobuf)
Mitarbeit in einem agilen Entwicklungsteam nach Scrum
Testgetriebene Entwicklung sowie Unterstützung bei der Frontend-Testautomatisierung (z. B. Unit- und UI-Tests)

Dein Profil

Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Medieninformatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
Erste bis mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Frontend-Entwicklung, idealerweise mit React
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML und CSS
Erfahrung im Umgang mit modernen Web-Technologien, Build-Tools und Paketmanagern (z. B. npm, Vite, Webpack)
Erfahrung in der Anbindung von REST-Schnittstellen und im Umgang mit strukturierten Datenformaten
Grundkenntnisse in UI-/UX-Prinzipien sowie Responsive Design
Vertrautheit mit agilen Entwicklungsmethoden, insbesondere Scrum
Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise sowie Teamfähigkeit
Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Über uns

CAIGOS. Technologie- und Dienstleistungspartner bei der digitalen Transformation.

Seit über 30 Jahren unterstützen wir unsere Kunden als Technologie- und Dienstleistungspartner bei der digitalen Transformation und helfen bei der Vereinfachung der Arbeitsprozesse im Asset Management, Workforce Management und der Geo-IT. Dabei hat unser Wirken einen besonderen Sinn. Denn unsere Kunden aus der Energie- und Wasserwirtschaft und der öffentlichen Verwaltung betreiben unverzichtbare zentrale Versorgungs- und Dienstleistungsinfrastrukturen für Staat, Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft. Dabei leisten wir mit unseren digitalen Lösungen und unserer Branchenexpertise einen wesentlichen Beitrag.

Unsere Kompetenzen.

Bestens ausgebildete IT Experten*innen mit langjähriger Projekterfahrung sind das Rückgrat unseres Erfolges. Es entspricht unserer DNA, stetig und mit selbstverständlicher Selbstehrlichkeit immer besser werden zu wollen. Deshalb hinterfragen wir regelmäßig und agil unsere Prozesse, führen gemeinsame Retrospektiven durch und sind jederzeit zu Veränderungen und offenem Diskurs bereit. So konnten wir eine führende Marktposition erreichen.

Eine starke Familie.

Als Teil des VIVAVIS Verbundes stehen wir unseren Kunden mit gebündelten Kompetenzen zur Seite. Wir treiben Digitalisierung voran und helfen, die zunehmende Komplexität in Arbeitsprozessen, Geschäftsmodellen und Marktbedingungen zu beherrschen. Mit Lösungen für E-Mobility, IoT, Kapazitätsoptimierung, Quartierslösungen, Asset- und Workforce Management, Geo-IT und Smart Metering unterstützen wir die digitale Transformation aus einer Hand.

Gemeinsam erfolgreich.

Wir sind überzeugt davon, dass sich Großes nur gemeinsam erreichen lässt. Daher suchen wir jederzeit neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die unser Team bereichern und zusammen mit uns wachsen wollen. Wir freuen uns auf dich.

originalJobContent:
Our mission

Help us accelerate scientific collaboration.

ResearchGate is the professional network for scientists and researchers. From climate change and emerging diseases to food security and the responsible development of AI, the challenges facing our world are complex. Still, we’re optimistic about the power of millions of scientists working together to tackle them. We provide scientists with the help and support they need by connecting them to the world’s most active scientific community.

We've built a platform that gives the world's scientists the tools and services they need to connect, collaborate, and advance their research. Over 25 million members from 193 countries use ResearchGate to share, discover, and discuss research.

What We're Looking For

The Role

We're looking for an enthusiastic frontend engineer with the skills and ability to turn great ideas into reality. You should have an in-depth understanding of current web technologies and front-end development, and be passionate about creating a great user experience. Your input will help us grow and maintain our React front-end.

Join a team that encourages you to explore, learn, and go beyond, while seeing your work lead to actionable results. Put your creative problem-solving and development skills into action and make a positive impact on science and society. This is a full-time position based in Germany.

The team

You will be an integral part of the product team dedicated to enhancing ResearchGate's publisher-facing product. This role involves designing, constructing, and refining the platform to further our mission of facilitating global scientific connections and ensuring open access to research. At present, our team is working on making ResearchGate a great platform for publishers to connect with existing and future authors.

Your immediate colleagues will consist of JavaScript and PHP engineers, an Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, a UX Designer, and a UX Writer. Our team places great value on our collaborative and communicative work culture and we eagerly anticipate integrating a new Engineer into this environment.

Responsibilites

Create web interfaces using TypeScript and React for new products and features.
Seamlessly integrate our front-end with our back-end world using GraphQL and PHP.
Maintain and improve existing features and related infrastructure.
Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and Software Engineers to deliver compelling publisher-facing products.

Requirements

5+ years frontend web development experience in TypeScript (React), CSS
Demonstrated ability to create code that is easily comprehensible, maintainable, and testable.
Eagerness to acquire new skills, delve into different technologies and programming languages, and a willingness to acknowledge areas where expertise may be lacking.
Approach problem-solving thoughtfully, embracing curiosity and maintaining an open-minded perspective.
You are comfortable incorporating AI-assisted development tools into your daily workflow and exercise strong engineering judgment when evaluating and refining their output.
Knowledge of GraphQL.
It would be a plus if you already had knowledge of relational and document-based databases (we use MongoDB and Postgres).

What We're Looking For

You take responsibility over your own solutions and continuously improve them.
You engage in proactive and efficient communication within our distributed work environment.
You focus on building a great product.
You excel at designing and creating coherent, user-centric interfaces that display complex information.

Why us

The interview process

We start with a short call with HR or an Engineering Manager to align on the details of the job inquiry.

originalJobContent:
OUR VISION

When people use our technology to "bridge the gap" between the physical and digital worlds, they don't just capture reality - they create a new one. In this new reality, they are smarter, more productive, more streamlined, and more creative - because they have the digital foundation to build the world they want to live in.

That's what NavVis offers in all our products and services: the tools to not just map the world as it is, but to pave the way to a better future. To forge something new. Physical or digital, there is only one reality. And it's the reality NavVis empowers people to build better.

THE OPPORTUNITY

At NavVis we build mobile mapping devices, including NavVis VLX and NavVis MLX, that operators use to capture and process spatial data in the field. This is a full stack engineering role covering the UI and backend stack that powers these devices. You will work across the stack, from the Angular and TypeScript UI operators use in the field to the Python and C++ backend that handles mapping, sensor data processing, and visualization. The software runs on Linux, across both x86 and arm64 platforms.

You will design and build the client-server architecture that connects high-performance robotics computations with a simple, interactive web interface, working closely with our in-house UI and UX designers to shape the mapping experience.

If you enjoy moving between frontend and backend work, and want hands-on exposure to robotics alongside modern web development, you will have the scope to shape how operators interact with NavVis's mapping devices.

How You Will Make An Impact

Build and maintain the UI application that powers NavVis VLX, NavVis MLX, and other mobile mapping devices, using Angular, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS
Develop the Python and C++ backend for sensor integration, communication, and data visualization on Linux-based x86 and arm64 mapping devices
Design and build the client-server architecture that connects high-performance robotics computations with a simple, interactive web interface
Shape the mobile mapping experience by collaborating closely with in-house UI and UX designers

What Will Help You Succeed In The Role

Master's or Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or a related field
5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including hands-on web application development
Strong experience with Angular, TypeScript, and JavaScript, including common JS testing frameworks such as Playwright or Cypress
Strong Python skills
Solid knowledge of Linux systems, including comfort with terminal tools and system-level debugging
Experience with C++, Java, or a similar statically typed, object-oriented language

Would be an added benefit

Exposure to robotics, handheld or embedded devices, or sensor systems such as LiDAR, cameras, or IMUs
Interest in mobile mapping and spatial data, shown through relevant projects or work

How We Will Know We Are a Perfect Match

Your recruiting partner for this role is Rina (she/her). You can expect to go through a screening call, and up to 4 rounds of interviews, where we would love to discover your passion and interests, introduce you to who we are and what drives us, and finally understand how we can potentially add value to each other's growth.

How We Will Keep You Smiling

It's important to take a break from work! We offer 30 days of paid time off per year
Affordable access to a vast network of fitness and wellness facilities through EGYM Wellpass subsidy
Deutschlandticket subsidy to support sustainable travel using public transport
We offer flexible working hours and a hybrid work setup, enabling you to plan your work around your life, and not your life around work!
We offer full visa and relocation support for international candidates
An attractive bike leasing model through JobRad, in line with our commitment towards sustainable mobility
A competitive compensation package that values the skills and experience you bring
Up to 4000 EUR employee referral bonus
Financial support for local language classes to help you in your journey of integrating into the culture!

About Us

NavVis is a technologically-focused, global leader in reality capture and digital factory solutions. Prominent manufacturers and laser scanning professionals around the world trust our ground-breaking technology, designed to capture and share the built environment as photorealistic digital twins. By bridging the physical and digital worlds, we're helping organizations make smarter decisions and build more efficient, connected operations.

With over 300 people from around 60 nationalities and offices around the globe, we're proud to be a truly international and diverse place to work. As a scaling company, we bring together the agility, innovation, and entrepreneurial mindset of a startup with the professionalism and reliability of an established enterprise — offering our team the best of both worlds.

You'll be part of an open culture that values trust, collaboration, and transparency. We are proud of our environment where diverse talent can thrive and where feedback fosters individual growth and development. Do you share our passion for disruptive technology and want to be part of our dynamic journey? At NavVis, you'll own your projects, bring innovative ideas to life, and have real opportunities to grow your career and be recognized for your impact.

We derive our strength from our diversity.

NavVis' unwavering commitment to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace has laid the foundation for our incredible growth. We thrive on the collective strength of our people who come from diverse backgrounds. We respect and value every experience associated with race, gender identity, sexual orientation, nationality, religion and disability. We do not discriminate on the basis of any of these, or other identities, and strongly encourage everyone to apply.

Together with you, we build NavVis!
