title: Full-Stack Engineer
originalJobContent:
Helios & Eos ist unser KI-Engineering-Studio aus Oldenburg — bewusst klein, technisch tief, agent-augmented. Aktuell sind wir zu dritt und bauen das Studio zum spezialisierten Partner für agentenbasierte KI-Adoption aus.

Unsere Kunden und Projekte sind vielfältig - von der Webappentwicklung für den globalen Asset-Manager, über das Training von 230+ Entwicklern für den internationalen FinTech-Konzern über die Prozessautomatisierung bei mehreren Mittelständlern ist alles dabei.

Mit dieser Rolle besetzen wir unseren ersten festen Engineering-Hire. Du bist nicht "noch ein Mitarbeiter" — du bist Macher:in in unserer nächsten Wachstumsphase, arbeitest direkt mit dem Gründer und prägst Stack, Architektur und Engineering-Kultur aktiv mit.

Du musst kein AI-/Agent-Experte sein, um anzufangen. Wenn du ein:e starke:r Full-Stack-Entwickler:in mit Neugier auf moderne KI- und Agent-Themen bist, lernst du das hier on-the-job — gemeinsam mit uns, an echten Projekten.

Aufgaben
Wir decken aktuell die gesamte Bandbreite eines KI-Engineering-Studios ab: Automation, Webapp-Entwicklung, Agent-Architekturen, Infrastruktur. Du bekommst die Teile, in denen du am stärksten bist — und wächst dort weiter, wo dich Neues reizt.

Konkret arbeitest du in zwei Welten:

• Interne Entwicklung — unsere eigenen Produkte und Infrastruktur. Hier baust du an Systemen, die wir selbst täglich nutzen und langfristig zu skalierbaren Plattformen ausbauen. Stack-Bandbreite: TypeScript, Next.js, React, Electron, Supabase, SQLite, n8n.

• Externe Entwicklung — Lösungen für unsere Kunden aus Asset-Management, FinTech und Mittelstand. Hier übersetzt du Geschäftsanforderungen in produktive Software — von Webapps und Datenpipelines bis zu Agent-Architekturen, je nach Aufgabe und Projekt.

Was genau du machst, hängt von deinem Profil ab. Bist du eher der Automation-Mensch, der saubere Pipelines und Workflows baut? Frontend-stark, mit einem Auge für UX und Performance? In Backend-Architekturen am wohlsten? Oder reizen dich Agent-Systeme und LLM-Orchestrierung am meisten?

Wir wollen deine Stärken nutzen, nicht dich in eine vorgefertigte Rolle pressen. Lernen on-the-job ist eingebaut — nicht versprochen.

Optional: Wenn du Lust hast, bist du in technischen Workshops, Architektur-Reviews oder On-Site-Terminen mit Kunden mit dabei. Kein Pflichtprogramm.

Qualifikation
Must-haves:

- 4+ Jahre Berufserfahrung als Full-Stack-Entwickler:in mit Erfahrungen in TypeScript / JavaScript, Python & Rust

- Gute Kenntnisse in Next.js, React und einer modernen Datenbank (Supabase, Postgres oder vergleichbar)

- Production-Mindset: Tests, CI/CD, Monitoring sind für dich Standard, kein "machen wir später"

- Backend-Erfahrung jenseits von "API-Endpoints anlegen" — Datenmodellierung, Auth, Performance, Caching

- Spielerische Neugier auf KI- und Agent-Tools — du probierst Claude, Cursor, neue Modelle, auch ohne dass du täglich damit arbeitest

- Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch (unsere Kunden sind international)

- "Just a chill guy/ girl"

Nice-to-haves (zählen, sind aber kein Filter):

- Praktische Erfahrung mit LLM-Integration in Production (Claude API, OpenAI o.ä.)

- Erfahrung mit Agent-Frameworks oder Multi-Agent-Setups (n8n mit AI, LangChain, eigene Tooling-Layer)

- Erfahrung mit Electron oder anderen Desktop-Frameworks

- DevOps-Erfahrung (Vercel, Cloudflare, AWS, Docker)

- Eigene Open-Source-Projekte oder Tech-Blog-Beiträge

- Erfahrung in B2B-Consulting oder direkter Arbeit mit Enterprise-Kunden

Benefits
- Direkter Founder-Zugang & Mitgestaltung — du arbeitest täglich mit Felix, prägst Stack, Architektur und Engineering-Kultur mit

- AI- und Agent-Engineering on-the-job lernen — du arbeitest mit Cursor, Claude Code, Anthropic API, und Multi-Agent-Setups produktiv und lernst von Anfang an, was viele Devs erst in unseren Trainings lernen

- Greenfield + 2026er-Tech-Stack — kein Legacy, kein Prozess-Theater

- Top-Hardware + alle Tools, die du brauchst

- Lern- & Konferenz-Budget — €2.000 / Jahr für Bücher, Kurse, Konferenzen

- 30 Urlaubstage

- Vor-Ort-Phase mit Übergang in Hybrid — erste ~3-6 Monate Präsenz im Büro (Oldenburg, August-Hanken-Straße) für Onboarding und Vertrauensaufbau, danach öffnen wir auf Hybrid (2-3 Tage Office, Rest remote)

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten — wir messen an Ergebnissen, nicht an Stempeluhren

- Production over Demos — was du baust, läuft im Echtbetrieb bei Kunden und in unseren Produkten

- Reale Wirkung — kein 200-Personen-Konzern, in dem deine Arbeit in einem Subprojekt verschwindet

Klingt nach dir? Schick uns deine Kurzvorstellung (kein Anschreiben-Theater — ein paar Sätze, was dich interessiert und warum, reichen), CV oder LinkedIn-Profil und gerne 1-2 Code-Samples, GitHub-Links oder Projekte, auf die du stolz bist.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung — und melden uns innerhalb von 5 Werktagen.

Job Description

Diebold Nixdorf automates, digitizes, and transforms the way people bank and shop. As a partner to the majority of the world's top 100 financial institutions and the world's top 25 retailers, our integrated solutions connect digital and physical channels conveniently, securely, and efficiently for millions of consumers every day. We are seeking a Software Engineer.

Software (Senior) Engineer (m/f/d)

Unsere Teams automatisieren, digitalisieren und transformieren die Bank- und Handelsgeschäfte von mehr als 75 Millionen Menschen rund um den Globus in dieser vernetzten verbraucherzentrierten Welt. Schließen Sie sich uns an und verbinden Sie Menschen in dieser wichtigen und wertvollen Rolle.

Wir suchen dich als Teamplayer in der Produktentwicklung unserer Vynamic Transaction Middleware – einer modernen, Java-basierten Lösung auf Basis einer zeitgemäßen Microservice-Architektur.

Dich erwartet ein spannendes und abwechslungsreiches Aufgabenfeld in einem großen, internationalen Team. Du arbeitest an einem Produkt, das bei den größten Banken der Welt im Einsatz ist – mit echtem Impact und jeder Menge Raum, dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Am wichtigsten ist uns: Du hast Lust, unsere Produkte nach vorne zu bringen, bist neugierig, lernst gerne dazu und arbeitest mit dem nötigen Anspruch an dir selbst.

Deine Aufgaben

Du gestaltest aktiv mit, wie wir generative KI entlang unseres gesamten Frontend-Entwicklungsprozesses einsetzen – von der Anforderung über Mockups und Implementierung bis hin zu automatisierten Tests
Du entwickelst und etablierst einen durchgängigen, KI-gestützten Workflow, der es uns erlaubt, aus Kundenanforderungen schnell klickbare Mockups, produktiven React-Code und passende Testabdeckung zu erzeugen
Du evaluierst Tools, Modelle und Prompts, baust wiederverwendbare Bausteine und Guidelines und hebst damit die Produktivität des gesamten Teams
Du entwickelst moderne, performante UIs mit React für unsere Domänen Payment Switching, POS- und ATM-Devicehandling – end-to-end von Design über Implementierung bis Test und Doku
Du nimmst Kundenanforderungen auf und übersetzt sie – unterstützt durch KI – in intuitive, durchdachte Frontend-Lösungen
Du sorgst für die saubere Anbindung an unsere Java-Backends (REST, BPMN, Netty, Jetty, CDI, JTA, JSF) und behältst Performance, Skalierbarkeit und Wartbarkeit im Blick
Du achtest auf termin- und qualitätsgerechte Lieferung und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Releases sitzen
Du wächst zum Ansprechpartner für moderne Frontend-Architektur und den sinnvollen, produktiven Einsatz von KI in der Softwareentwicklung


Was du mitbringst

Ein abgeschlossenes Informatikstudium oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung
Du bist fit in Java und kennst dich in der Open-Source-Welt gut aus
Erfahrungen mit React
Generative KI ist für dich kein Buzzword – du weißt, wie man sie sinnvoll in der Softwareentwicklung einsetzt
Du denkst dich schnell in neue Themen rein, arbeitest strukturiert und knackst auch komplexe Probleme gerne
Du willst gestalten, Verantwortung übernehmen und Dinge wirklich vorantreiben


Ihre Bewerbung

Bitte schicken Sie uns folgende Unterlagen in einem Dokument:
Lebenslauf
Anschreiben
Arbeits-(Zeugnisse)


Warum Du Dich Diebold Nixdorf anschließen solltest?

Diebold Nixdorf ist mehr als ein Zusammenschluss. Es ist vielmehr ein neues Unternehmen im Zeitalter der Transformation. Seit insgesamt mehr als 150 Jahren haben wir die Zukunft mitgestaltet, unsere Kunden langfristig strategisch begleitet und den Weg für Innovationen bereitet.

Heute übernehmen wir eine führende Rolle als Technologietreiber und -wegbereiter im Connected Commerce. Wir verbinden die physische und digitale Welt des Zahlungsverkehres, um Verbrauchern ein noch reibungsloseres Kundenerlebnis zu schaffen – in einer Omnichannel-Welt, die ständig im Wandel ist und in der Verbraucher 24/7 ständige Verfügbarkeit erwarten.

In dieser Welt voller Chancen sind wir besser denn je aufgestellt, um die Zukunft erfolgreich zu gestalten

Gestalten Sie mit!

Diebold Nixdorf ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit und wir legen Wert auf Vielfalt in unserem Unternehmen. Wir diskriminieren nicht aufgrund von Rasse, Religion, Hautfarbe, nationaler Herkunft, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Familienstand, Veteranenstatus oder Behinderungsstatus.

** An alle Personalagenturen: Diebold Nixdorf akzeptiert keine Lebensläufe von Agenturen. Diebold Nixdorf ist nicht verantwortlich für Gebühren im Zusammenhang mit unaufgeforderten Lebensläufen **

Expect more. Connect more. Be more at Diebold Nixdorf. Our teams automate, digitize, and transform the way more than 75 million people around the globe bank and shop in this hyper-connected, consumer-centric world. Join us in connecting people to commerce in this vital, rewarding role.

We are looking for a team player to join the product development of our Vynamic Transaction Middleware, a modern Java-based solution built on a contemporary microservices architecture.

You can expect a challenging and diverse role within a large international team. You will work on a product used by some of the world's largest banks, delivering real impact while offering plenty of opportunities for both professional and personal growth.

Most importantly, we are looking for someone who is motivated to drive our products forward, is curious, eager to learn, and committed to high standards of quality and performance.

Your Responsibilities

Actively shape how we use Generative AI throughout our entire frontend development process, from requirements gathering and mockups to implementation and automated testing.
Develop and establish an end-to-end AI-powered workflow that enables us to quickly generate clickable mockups, production-ready React code, and appropriate test coverage from customer requirements.
Evaluate tools, models, and prompts; create reusable components and guidelines; and increase the productivity of the entire team.
Develop modern, high-performance UIs with React for our Payment Switching, POS, and ATM Device Handling domains, covering the entire lifecycle from design and implementation to testing and documentation.
Gather customer requirements and, with the support of AI, translate them into intuitive and well-designed frontend solutions.
Ensure clean integration with our Java backends (REST, BPMN, Netty, Jetty, CDI, JTA, JSF) while maintaining a focus on performance, scalability, and maintainability.
Ensure timely, high-quality delivery and contribute to successful product releases.
Grow into a key point of contact for modern frontend architecture and the effective, productive use of AI in software development.


What You Bring

A degree in Computer Science or a comparable qualification.
Strong Java skills and a solid understanding of the open-source ecosystem.
Experience with React.
Generative AI is more than just a buzzword to you; you understand how to apply it effectively in software development.
The ability to quickly familiarize yourself with new topics, work in a structured manner, and enjoy solving complex problems.
A desire to take ownership, drive initiatives, and make a real impact.

Resume/CV
Cover Letter

Flexible working time models and modern working conditions
Individual career and training opportunities
30 days of leave p.a. and special leave due to events

Employer-financed company pension scheme to provide additional security for your future

Brightest minds + technology and innovation + business transformation

The people of Diebold Nixdorf are 23,000+ teammates of diverse talents and expertise in more than 130 countries, harnessing future technologies to deliver personalized, secure consumer experiences that connect people to commerce. title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (m/w/d)
originalJobContent:
Join our small, hands-on team to create AI solutions in enterprise context and launch your own ideas at the same time. You’ll have real freedom, shape the tech, and share in the success (salary, earnings share and equity in products we launch). If you have a startup spirit, enjoy side projects, and want to see your work make a real impact, we'd love to connect.

About us

Overfly is a Berlin-based Partner for Applied AI. We're a team of engineers, product builders and strategists who help enterprises find high-impact AI use cases, then design and build them to production.

Tasks
What you'll be doing

**

Technical leadership**

• Owning the technical direction of client projects end-to-end, from architecture decisions (multi-tenant cloud, auth, data isolation) to production-ready delivery on enterprise cloud infrastructure (Azure, GCP, OVH)

• Making and defending the unsexy calls: IaC standards, release strategies, CI/CD pipelines, security architecture, deployment topology

• Designing systems that hold up in regulated enterprise environments, including DSGVO, ISO 27001, SOC2, pen-tests, and compliance reviews

Stakeholder navigation in complex enterprise settings

• Being the technical voice in client meetings. You translate trade-offs, scope feasibility, and shape requirements with non-technical decision makers, IT security, legal, and C-levels in parallel

• Running the room when enterprise stakeholders disagree: mediating between internal IT (firewalls, VPN, network architecture), external partners (hosting, auth providers), and process owners with conflicting agendas

• Managing expectations proactively: surfacing risks early, correcting unrealistic cost or timeline assumptions with real numbers, and escalating through the right channels when needed

• Communicating commitments that hold. Binding dates, clear scope, honest status. Not optimism disguised as a plan

Forward Deployed work

• Embedding into client teams, shipping real features alongside their engineers and process owners, often across multiple organisations at once

• Ramping quickly into unfamiliar codebases, legacy enterprise systems (Oracle, SAP-adjacent environments) and complex domains (utility metering, insurance, FMCG)

• Translating user reality (e.g. the Sachbearbeiterin who wants Excel-like UX) into something your engineering team can actually build

Team organisation

• Coordinating internal engineers, external partners, and client staff on the same delivery: clear ownership, clear handoffs, clear status

• Unblocking problems across projects, reviewing code, and raising the bar on how we ship

• Collaborating with strategy and product to turn business goals into technical plans with budget and timeline attached

Hands-on engineering

• Building full-stack solutions with TypeScript (React, Node, Next.js, Tailwind) and integrating AI where it creates real value, not where it's trendy

• Staying ahead on AI tooling and pulling what works into our projects and workflows

Requirements
What you'll bring

• 5–8+ years of full-stack experience (React, Node, TypeScript) and at least one production deployment you personally owned from architecture to go-live on a major cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP or equivalent)

• Proven ability to own technical direction from start to finish: architecture, infra, CI/CD, security, delivery

• Consulting or agency experience working directly with enterprise clients, ideally in regulated environments (utilities, finance, insurance, pharma)

• Outstanding communication skills in German and English. You can explain a VPN trade-off to a non-technical CFO and a compliance officer in the same meeting, and both leave convinced

• Calm under stakeholder pressure. You know when to push back, when to escalate, and when to just ship

• An entrepreneurial mindset. You turn ambiguity into plans and plans into working products

• German at a professional working level. Non-negotiable for our enterprise client conversations

Tech we use

Our current tools include:

• AI frameworks and APIs (LangChain, OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Azure AI)

• TypeScript (React, Node), Tailwind CSS, Next.JS, Vite, React, React Router

• Analytics tools like Mixpanel and PostHog

• Databases like Supabase, Postgresql, Azure Cosmos DB

• Deployment platforms (Vercel, Google Cloud)

Benefits
What we offer

• Real equity in the products we build together, with an option to invest further

• 4-day work week as team default

• Customizable perks (transportation pass, gym membership, rental bike), choose what fits your life

• Autonomous, self-managed work environment

• Experienced, flat team structure, no corporate hierarchy here

• Opportunity to build practical, valuable AI products used by real people

• Remote or hybrid work model: 2 days/week at Delta Campus, the rest remote

• Competitive salary plus annual bonus based on company performance

How to apply

We don't need a polished CV. Just send us your LinkedIn profile or a quick overview of your background, plus short answers (2–5 sentences each) to these prompts:

• A project you built yourself and what made it special

• Why you're excited about AI, especially something you think most people get wrong

• A full-stack project where you took technical leadership

• A clever non-technical solution or "hack" you've used to gain an advantage

This helps us quickly understand who you are and what motivates you.

guten Englischkenntnissen.

erste oder vertiefte Erfahrung mit Cloud- oder DevOps-Themen.

AI ∶ RAG-Pipelines, LLMs, Pinecone, Vercel AI SDK, Anthropic AI SDK, OpenAI SDK</ Warum wir? Wir reden Klartext, verzichten auf Buzzwords und setzen auf Authentizität. originalJobContent:
Einleitung

Bei Rohde & Schwarz entwickeln wir am Standort Chemnitz innovative Software- und Systemlösungen für unsere Test- und Messtechnik. Gemeinsam mit unseren Teams aus Softwareentwicklung, Signalverarbeitung und Elektrotechnik gestalten wir leistungsfähige Messgeräte und Anwendungen, die unsere Kunden bei der Entwicklung und Analyse anspruchsvoller elektronischer Systeme unterstützen. Als Teil eines internationalen Technologieunternehmens mit über 16000 Mitarbeitenden arbeiten wir dabei standortübergreifend an Lösungen, die höchste Anforderungen an Präzision, Performance und Qualität erfüllen.

Aufgaben

Du konzipierst, entwickelst und implementierst moderne Web User Interfaces für unsere Messgeräte mit Fokus auf Anwendungen im Bereich Signal- und Waveform-Generatoren – hauptsächlich mit React und TypeScript.
Du entwickelst die zugehörigen Backends in C++ und sorgst für eine zuverlässige Integration der Benutzeroberfläche in unsere Embedded-Software und Geräteplattform.
Du evaluierst neue Technologien und Frameworks im Web-Umfeld und überführst geeignete Ansätze in produktionsreife Softwarelösungen.
Du gestaltest intuitive und ergonomische Benutzeroberflächen und legst dabei besonderen Wert auf eine konsistente und hochwertige User Experience.
Du entwickelst Unit- und Integrationstests für Frontend und Backend und etablierst automatisierte Tests frühzeitig im Entwicklungsprozess.
Du implementierst End-to-End-, System- und Visual-Regression-Tests, unter anderem mit Python, und stellst damit die Stabilität der Benutzeroberfläche über verschiedene Releases hinweg sicher.
Du nutzt KI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge für Prototyping, Testgenerierung und wiederkehrende Entwicklungsaufgaben und validierst die Ergebnisse durch etablierte Code-Review- und Testprozesse.
Du arbeitest eng mit interdisziplinären Teams aus Software-, Embedded- und Geräteentwicklung zusammen und gestaltest neue Funktionen von der technischen Konzeption bis zur Integration.

Qualifikationen

Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Elektrotechnik, Nachrichtentechnik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung.
Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in modernen Webtechnologien, insbesondere React, TypeScript, HTML5 und CSS3, und bist mit Hooks, Functional Components und State Management vertraut.
Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung strukturierter, wartbarer und modularer Webanwendungen und ein gutes Verständnis moderner Software- und Designprinzipien.
Du bist mit Frontend-Testing und entsprechenden Frameworks wie Jest, React Testing Library oder Playwright vertraut.
Du bringst erste praktische Erfahrung in der objektorientierten Softwareentwicklung mit C++ mit – idealerweise in der Backend-, API- oder gerätenahen Softwareentwicklung.
Du bist mit Git, Code Reviews, automatisierten Tests und CI/CD-Prozessen vertraut.
Kenntnisse in Python sowie Erfahrung mit End-to-End-, System- oder Visual-Regression-Tests sind von Vorteil.
Idealerweise hast du bereits Berührungspunkte mit Embedded Systems, elektronischer Messtechnik oder technisch anspruchsvollen Geräten und Anwendungen.
Du arbeitest gerne an der Schnittstelle zwischen moderner Webentwicklung und technischen Systemen, bringst eigene Ideen ein und arbeitest strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich.
Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und arbeitest gerne in interdisziplinären Teams.

Kontakt und weitere Informationen

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Am besten online über das Bewerbungsportal. Bei Fragen stehen unser Chatbot Paul und das Recruiting-Team jederzeit gerne zur Verfügung.

Wir bieten eine inklusive Arbeitsumgebung, in der alle Menschen ihre Fähigkeiten und Talente entfalten können, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, Identität und anderen Merkmalen.

Bei Rohde & Schwarz entwickeln und produzieren wir Lösungen in den Bereichen Test & Measurement, Technology Systems sowie Networks & Cybersecurity – mit der Vision einer sicheren und vernetzten Welt. Von der Software bis zur Endfertigung gestalten unsere über 15.000 Mitarbeitenden Produkte und Systeme, die die technologische Souveränität unserer Kunden aus Wirtschaft, Behörden und hoheitlichem Umfeld sichern und weltweit Standards setzen. title: Full Stack Engineer Google Cloud (all genders)
originalJobContent:
Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.

DEINE ROLLE

Cloud-Entwicklung: Du entwickelst skalierbare Anwendungen mit modernen Technologien und verbesserst bestehende Systeme kontinuierlich.
Teamarbeit: In einem agilen Umfeld arbeitest du eng mit Projektmanagement und Development zusammen – immer auf Augenhöhe.
Technologie-Expertise: Du evaluierst neue Tools und Frameworks, um innovative Lösungen für unsere Projekte zu schaffen.
Qualitätssicherung: Du teilst dein Wissen im Team, führst Code-Reviews durch und sorgst für sauberen, getesteten Code.
Kundenfokus: Du berätst unsere Kunden partnerschaftlich und setzt ihre Anforderungen in passgenaue Lösungen um.
Wissensentwicklung: Auf Konferenzen und in Zertifizierungen holst du dir frische Impulse und bringst sie ins Team ein - der direkte Draht zu Google Deutschland, der Google University und dem Google Entwicklungsteam inklusive.

DEIN PROFIL

Programmiererfahrung: Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in Backend (Java, Python, Node.js) und Frontend (React, Angular, GWT) Entwicklung.
Software-Qualität: Clean Code, TDD und Architekturprinzipien sind für dich selbstverständlicher Teil der Entwicklung.
API-Know-how: Du konzipierst und entwickelst RESTful- oder GraphQL-APIs mit klarem Fokus auf Performance.
Datenbankkenntnisse: Ob SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL) oder NoSQL (BigQuery, Firestore) – du bewegst dich sicher in beiden Welten.
DevOps-Mindset: Git, CI/CD-Tools (Jenkins, GitLab-CI) und ein „You build it, you run it“-Ansatz sind dir vertraut.
KI Kompetenz: Du setzt KI-Tools in deinem Fachgebiet souverän ein, bewertest die Ergebnisse kritisch und unterstützt Kunden und adessi dabei, Potenziale von KI zu nutzen.
Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und guten Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation.

Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

title: (Senior) Full-stack Engineer | Climate Tech startup
originalJobContent:
Intro

Carbmee builds the System of Action for carbon and environmental data in the world's most complex industrial sectors: automotive, defense, heavy manufacturing. Backed by €20M Series A, growing fast out of Berlin and Munich.

We're looking for a Fullstack Engineer who treats the codebase like a product, not a ticket queue. You should be equally comfortable in React/Next.js, NestJS, Python, and PostgreSQL.

This is not a maintenance role. We're a small engineering team solving genuinely hard data and integration problems for enterprise customers who don't tolerate sloppy software. If you want to ship fast, own outcomes, and work with people who studied and worked at the top of their field, this is your kind of place.

Please note: at this stage we're not able to offer visa sponsorship. Candidates must already have the right to work in Germany.

Your tasks

Build and ship end-to-end features across the stack (React/Next.js, NestJS, Python, PostgreSQL)
Collaborate closely with product managers and designers to solve real customer problems
Own your work - from idea to deployment and beyond
Sit with product and customers directly: you're expected to have opinions on what we build, not just how
Work on a service-oriented architecture deployed on AWS
Bring your ideas, challenge assumptions, and shape our technical direction with the team
(If senior) Mentor others and help us raise the engineering bar

Your profile

CS degree from a top university: you've been trained to think rigorously about complex problems
3+ years shipping production B2B SaaS software, not just personal projects or bootcamp portfolios
Deep proficiency in TypeScript/React and Node.js or Python
Solid grasp of relational databases and cloud infra (AWS)
Evidence of ownership: a side project, an OSS contribution, a system you built and are proud of: not just a job history
You ask "why" before "how," and you've pushed back on a product decision before
You are excited to join our diverse and international team in Munich

Don't feel like you meet all the criteria? We get it: confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. We'll let you in on a little secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. Carbmee is a place where everyone can grow. So however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come to work on a Monday morning.

Benefits

Unique & Powerful Mission: join a fast-growing and ambitious tech company that is shaping the future of carbon management and fighting climate change
Compensation & Rewards: a steep learning curve and ownership from day one. We offer an attractive compensation package, including virtual stock options
Health & Wellbeing: Urban Sports Club subscription to stay healthy & fit.1:1 coaching sessions with Nilohealth for your mental well-being.
Flexible & Balanced: A hybrid setup with 3 days/week in our Munich office. Real collaboration time with the team, plus the flexibility to structure the rest of your week where you focus best.
Team Culture: Our transparency, Humility, and Accountability values create a unique and supportive working environment. Be part of a multinational, motivated team that thinks work should be fun!
Connection & Networking: Summer Offsite, Winter Party, and regular team events We give you plenty of opportunities to connect with people, strengthen cross-functional relationships, and boost collaboration
Trust & Transparency: monthly All-Hands Meetings, weekly update newsletters, and Founders Q&As. We keep you informed on current company numbers and goals

About Us

carbmee is an Enterprise Software company built for the architectural backbone of the global economy. In an era where sustainability defines a company’s right to operate, we provide the System of Action for the world’s most complex manufacturing sectors with a strong footprint in Automotive and Defense.

We specialize in high-stakes, large-scale enterprise deployments where environmental data is no longer just a reporting requirement, but a critical strategic asset. Our platform empowers global industry leaders to transform fragmented data points into actionable intelligence, enabling them to make the defining decisions for the future of their products and supply chains.

At the heart of carbmee is a team of world-class talent: a powerhouse of engineers, industry experts, and visionaries dedicated to solving the most pressing industrial challenges of our time. Join ACAI (Advanced Calendar Improvement), a team dedicated to making day-to-day practice operations more efficient and less mentally exhausting for healthcare professionals and their teams.
Practice operations are often fragmented across post-its, emails, SMS, phone calls, oral instructions, and individual memory. This makes it difficult for teams to know what needs to be done, who owns it, how urgent it is, and what has already happened.
As a Software Engineer, you will help build products that centralise work, improve coordination, and automate administrative tasks across the practice; directly contributing to a smoother experience for healthcare professionals, staff, and patients.
Your responsibilities
Develop reliable, intuitive features for Task Manager, Patient Flow Management, patient intake, appointment proposals, and telesecretaryship workflows

On ACAI, you'll primarily work with Ruby and Kotlin on the backend and React with TypeScript and Rails on the frontend. Doctolib's broader technology environment also includes Java, Python and Swift.
We leverage AI in an ethical manner across our products to empower patients and healthcare professionals. Discover our AI vision.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
originalJobContent:
Location: Auckland
Type: Full Time, Permanent
Reports To: CTO, Ben Tan
Start Date: Immediate
Compensation: $170+ NZD + equity
Application link: https://concordvisa.careers.empathix.xyz/jobs/0JMNXU8M8FRZ

The Opportunity
Immigration is one of the last professional services yet to be reimagined by tech, which makes it one of the most exciting places to be an engineer right now. Most of the industry still runs on shared drives and email chains with manual human analysis - we're building the platform that replaces all of that. You'll join a growing engineering team working across frontend, backend, AI integrations, and third-party APIs on a modern full-stack JS platform, shipping features where the stakes are real and no two tickets look the same. If you want to build something with LLMs, security constraints, and multi-jurisdiction complexity to keep it interesting - this is that role.

About Concord
We exist so that exceptional people and companies can work wherever their ambition takes them.
Concord is a specialist immigration firm built for the speed and complexity of high-growth tech. We've already processed 3,000+ visas across US, Australia, New Zealand, and the UK for clients like Andreessen Horowitz, Blackbird, Tracksuit, and Zuru, and we’re just getting started.
We spun out of Crimson Education because we saw an industry ripe for reinvention. Our founding team has built and scaled companies before; now we're combining that operator DNA with purpose-built technology to make global mobility seamless and transparent. We built our own platform to prove it: our custom-built app gives applicants real-time visibility into their case and automates the admin so our highly experienced legal team can focus on the high-judgement work that moves cases forward.
We hire ambitious problem-solvers who choose ownership over complacency. If you want a seat at a startup where you ship things that matter, keep reading.

About the Role
You'll be a Senior Engineer on Concord's Auckland-based product team, building on a modern full-stack JS platform (TypeScript, React, PostgreSQL). The work spans the full surface area - from drafting tools and automated review and feedback systems to MCP interfaces and HRIS integrations.
A part of the role is R&D around large language models: figuring out where they genuinely help (beyond gimmicky demos), testing and optimising AI features for performance and reliability, and extending AI into internal tooling for productivity, security coverage, and code quality as we scale.
Security is non-negotiable. You'll work closely with the CTO on how we isolate client data across multi-jurisdiction workflows with complex permission requirements, and contribute to critical decisions about what data is exposed to an LLM – Passports, financials, family relationships, biometrics - this is the most sensitive data a person can hand over.
You won't be executing someone else's spec. You'll work directly with immigration lawyers, case managers, and ops to design workflows and features that scale across jurisdictions and visa categories. This role reports to the CTO, and the engineering team currently works four days a week from our Parnell offices.
Success looks like: shipping high-stakes features with confidence, meaningful AI capabilities embedded into the platform, and a security posture that matches the sensitivity of the data we hold.

What you'll own
Platform development: Build across the full stack (frontend, backend, AI, third-party APIs) on a modern JS platform, shipping features that streamline how our business operates. You'll also work closely with the CTO on how we isolate sensitive immigration data across multi-jurisdiction workflows, manage complex user permissions, and control what's exposed to language models.
AI R&D & integration: Explore, validate, and implement LLM-powered features in both customer-facing and internal workflows — including extending AI into Concord's own development workflows for productivity, security coverage, and code quality — with an emphasis on where they genuinely improve performance and accuracy.
Product shaping: Partner with domain experts (lawyers, case managers, ops) to design workflows, automations, and features that scale globally — petition drafting tools, feedback systems, HRIS integrations, and more.
Who we're looking for
You'll thrive at Concord (regardless of the role) if:
You're energised by new challenges and ambiguity, not paralysed by it. When something's hard or unclear, your instinct is to figure it out rather than wait for instructions.
You communicate with clarity and precision, whether the audience is a nervous applicant, a time-poor CEO, or a room full of people who know nothing about immigration.
You're wired for outcomes. You don't confuse being busy with being effective.
You're curious by default. You experiment with new tools, challenge existing processes, and consider "we've always done it this way" a poor excuse.
To succeed in this role you’ll also need:
5+ years building software, ideally on SaaS platforms or in growth startups. You've led, architected, built, tested, and shipped features where failure isn't an option and you know what it takes to get them across the line.
Experience with modern JS frameworks (TypeScript, React), strong experience with SQL-based databases, and familiarity or exposure to AI/LLM frameworks.
A problem-solving mindset. You thrive on untangling complex problems and delivering elegant, straightforward solutions.
Product-first thinking. You care about what you build, not just the code but how it feels and performs for users. You stand behind the design decisions you make.
Why you’ll love working at Concord
Your work changes lives, and you'll get to see it happen. It's rare to work somewhere the impact is this tangible. You'll help a founder land in San Francisco and later watch them announce their Series A. You'll help a brilliant operator relocate for the role of a lifetime, and see their journey evolve from there. The impact here isn't abstract. You can trace a direct line from what you did to a company scaling or a person's career trajectory changing for the better.
You'll grow faster here than anywhere else. We're early-stage and scaling fast, which means you'll get exposure and responsibility that would take years to earn at a larger organisation. We prefer to stretch people into opportunities early - leadership and strategy roles open up as we grow, and we'd rather promote from within than hire from outside. You'll also have access to development opportunities across our parent company, Crimson Education, where 33% of all hires last year were internal moves. Everyone gets a $1,500 annual learning budget, direct feedback through radical candour, and no space to coast.
We’re high trust, and high ownership. Everyone at Concord holds equity through the Crimson Education ESOP scheme. When the company wins, you win. Day-to-day, that ownership mindset extends to how you work: we're office-first but flexible around the edges. If you need to shift your morning for school drop-off or block out an afternoon for focused work - that's your call. We hired you for your judgement, we're not going to micromanage how you use it.
The people here are the reason it works. We're a small team of experienced operators, many of whom are immigrants themselves. We've sat on both sides - as the person navigating a visa process, and the one trying to hire across borders. That lived experience means we hold ourselves to a higher standard, because we know what's at stake. We're tightly collaborative, we challenge each other constantly, and everyone here is expected to contribute at the level the work demands - no bystanders.
Everyone’s welcome
Concord Visa is built on the belief that moving countries should be possible for everyone. We bring that same philosophy to our own team. We welcome applications regardless of ethnicity, gender identity, disability, age, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic. And yes, for the right person, we'll sponsor your visa. We know a thing or two about that.

How we hire

The Opportunity
Immigration is one of the last major industries still running on email chains and shared drives, and we're building the platform that replaces all of that. You'll join a growing engineering team working across frontend, backend, AI integrations, and third-party APIs on a modern full-stack JS platform, shipping features that have real impact on real people's lives. If you want to level up fast with a global-growth mindset, work with LLMs in production, and build something that actually matters - this is the place to do it.

About Concord
We exist so that exceptional people and companies can work wherever their ambition takes them.
Concord is a specialist immigration firm built for the speed and complexity of high-growth tech. We've already processed 3,000+ visas across US, Australia, New Zealand, and the UK for clients like Andreessen Horowitz, Blackbird, Tracksuit, and Zuru, and we’re just getting started.

We spun out of Crimson Education because we saw an industry ripe for reinvention. Our founding team has built and scaled companies before; now we're combining that operator DNA with purpose-built technology to make global mobility seamless and transparent. We built our own platform to prove it: our custom-built app gives applicants real-time visibility into their case and automates the admin so our highly experienced legal team can focus on the high-judgement work that moves cases forward.
We hire ambitious problem-solvers who choose ownership over complacency. If you want a seat at a startup where you ship things that matter, keep reading.

About the Role
You'll be a full-stack developer on Concord's Auckland-based product team, building on a modern JS platform (TypeScript, React, Hono, PostgreSQL, Mantine). The work spans the full surface area - from client-facing visa workflows and automated document generation to internal tools and third-party integrations.

You'll get hands-on experience with LLMs in production - not just prototyping, but figuring out where AI genuinely improves outcomes and shipping features that rely on it. You'll also work closely with immigration lawyers, case managers, and ops to understand the domain and build features that solve real problems across jurisdictions.

Security matters deeply here. Immigration data includes passports, financials, and biometrics — you'll learn to build with privacy and data isolation front of mind, and contribute to how we manage sensitive data across complex permission structures.

This isn't an environment where you'll be heads-down on tickets someone else scoped. You'll have input into what gets built and how, with senior engineers and the CTO available to support your growth.

What you'll help build
Feature development — Build across the full stack (UX, backend, APIs) on a modern JS platform, delivering features that streamline everything from evidence collection to automated form generation.
AI-assisted features — Contribute to LLM-powered features in both customer-facing and internal workflows, learning what works in production and what doesn't.
Domain expertise — Work directly with immigration lawyers and case managers to understand complex workflows and translate them into clean, scalable software.
Security-conscious development — Build with privacy and data isolation as defaults, contributing to how we protect sensitive client data across multi-jurisdiction workflows.
Internal tooling & quality — Help extend and improve our internal tools, testing practices, and development workflows as the team and platform scale. These tools allow us to rapidly prototype and experiment with new ways of working.
Who we're looking for
You'll thrive at Concord (regardless of the role) if:
You're energised by new challenges and ambiguity, not paralysed by it. When something's hard or unclear, your instinct is to figure it out rather than wait for instructions.
You communicate with clarity and precision, whether the audience is a nervous applicant, a time-poor CEO, or a room full of people who know nothing about immigration.
You're wired for outcomes. You don't confuse being busy with being effective.
You're curious by default. You experiment with new tools, challenge existing processes, and consider "we've always done it this way" a poor excuse.

To succeed in this role you’ll also need:
2–4 years building software professionally, ideally on web applications or SaaS platforms. You've shipped features to production and understand what that takes end to end.
Good experience/exposure with modern JS frameworks (TypeScript, React) and working knowledge of SQL-based databases.
A genuine curiosity about AI and LLMs - you don't need deep experience, but you should be excited about working with them and forming your own view on where they add value.
A product-first mindset. You care about what you build, not just the code but how it feels and performs for users.
Strong communication skills - comfortable asking questions, contributing in discussions with non-technical stakeholders, and clear written communication.
Why you’ll love working at Concord
Your work changes lives, and you'll get to see it happen. It's rare to work somewhere the impact is this tangible. You'll help a founder land in San Francisco and later watch them announce their Series A. You'll help a brilliant operator relocate for the role of a lifetime, and see their journey evolve from there. The impact here isn't abstract. You can trace a direct line from what you did to a company scaling or a person's career trajectory changing for the better.
You'll grow faster here than anywhere else. We're early-stage and scaling fast, which means you'll get exposure and responsibility that would take years to earn at a larger organisation. We prefer to stretch people into opportunities early - leadership and strategy roles open up as we grow, and we'd rather promote from within than hire from outside. You'll also have access to development opportunities across our parent company, Crimson Education, where 33% of all hires last year were internal moves. Everyone gets a $1,500 annual learning budget, direct feedback through radical candour, and no space to coast.
We’re high trust, and high ownership. Everyone at Concord holds equity through the Crimson Education ESOP scheme. When the company wins, you win. Day-to-day, that ownership mindset extends to how you work: we're office-first but flexible around the edges. If you need to shift your morning for school drop-off or block out an afternoon for focused work - that's your call. We hired you for your judgement, we're not going to micromanage how you use it.
The people here are the reason it works. We're a small team of experienced operators, many of whom are immigrants themselves. We've sat on both sides - as the person navigating a visa process, and the one trying to hire across borders. That lived experience means we hold ourselves to a higher standard, because we know what's at stake. We're tightly collaborative, we challenge each other constantly, and everyone here is expected to contribute at the level the work demands - no bystanders.
Everyone’s welcome
Concord Visa is built on the belief that moving countries should be possible for everyone. We bring that same philosophy to our own team. We welcome applications regardless of ethnicity, gender identity, disability, age, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic. *And yes, for the right person, we'll sponsor your visa. We know a thing or two about that.*

The Move My Money Squad sits at the heart of ASB's digital banking experience, helping customers move money simply, securely and confidently. The squad owns and enhances key payments and transfer experiences across ASB's digital channels, ensuring customers can manage their money whenever and wherever they need to.

Working in a highly visible and business-critical area, the squad is responsible for customer payment journeys, money movement capabilities and the integrations that support them. Collaborating with designers and product teams to translate customer needs into technical solutions
Championing engineering quality through testing, code reviews and best practices

Contributing to architecture, design decisions and continuous improvement initiatives
Supporting the delivery of reliable, scalable and high-performing digital banking solutions

You're a passionate software engineer who enjoys building great products, solving complex problems and helping others succeed. You're equally comfortable contributing hands-on technical expertise and providing guidance to engineers around you.

You take pride in delivering quality software, enjoy working collaboratively, and understand how strong engineering practices contribute to outstanding customer experiences.

Strong commercial experience building modern customer-facing applications using React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS and SCSS

Solid full-stack capability, including experience building and consuming REST APIs and working with .NET-based services and applications

ASP.NET and MVC development experience
Experience working within large-scale, customer-facing digital platforms
Experience contributing across both front-end and backend codebases

Working at ASB

At ASB, we're committed to helping our people get one step ahead as well. We know that meaningful careers are built through challenging work, continuous learning, genuine flexibility and the support of great people around you.

You'll have the opportunity to work on technology that impacts New Zealanders every day while being part of a culture that values collaboration, inclusion, wellbeing and growth.

Some Of The Benefits Of Working With Us Include

Hybrid and flexible working options
Five days of lifestyle leave each year
Learning and development opportunities to grow your technical and professional skills
Internal mobility and career growth across ASB
Health, wellbeing and employee assistance support
Banking, insurance and partner benefits
Generous parental leave provisions
Access to engineering communities, mentoring and knowledge-sharing networks
A supportive and inclusive culture where you can bring your whole self to work

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to work on products that sit at the centre of everyday banking. The work is meaningful, the engineering challenges are genuine, and the impact is visible. Every improvement delivered by the squad helps customers manage their money more effectively and confidently.

You'll be part of a highly collaborative engineering environment where you'll have the freedom to contribute ideas, influence technical direction and continue developing your expertise. Whether you're looking to deepen your technical skills, broaden your impact as a senior engineer or help shape the future of digital experiences at one of New Zealand's leading organisations, you'll find plenty of opportunity here.

Apply Now

If you're excited by the opportunity to build modern digital experiences, solve meaningful engineering challenges and help deliver better outcomes for New Zealanders, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help us create digital experiences that keep our customers one step ahead.

Position Overview

We're accesso Intelligence (powered by Dexibit). 🦖 🎢 🐅 🗼 🖼️ 🎡 🏟️

We love dinosaurs and data. Our AI product helps visitor attractions — from museums to zoos to theme parks — make sense of their data and make better decisions. We work with big international names alongside local favourites like MOTAT and Weta, and we've picked up a few awards along the way from HiTech, NZIBA, TIN and more.

Dexibit recently joined accesso, a global technology company serving over 1,000 venues across 30+ countries. That means our platform, our reach, and the complexity of the problems we get to solve just got a lot bigger.

Location: Auckland-based, hybrid (~3 days in our Parnell office / ~2 at home)

Reports to: VP, accesso Intelligence

Travel ✈️ Requirement: none

What We Build

accesso Intelligence brings together deep domain knowledge, an AI-ready data platform, and an agentic interface. We create value for our customers by addressing non-trivial tasks like strategic modelling, scheduling, operational reporting, and analysing visitor feedback.

Under the hood, the AI layer orchestrates real business logic and APIs: integration packs, custom datasets and benchmarks, context control features, and our query and visualisation infrastructure.

The agentic interface is where we're investing new feature development — think streaming, context window management, tool orchestration, and sandboxed execution. There's real depth here, and real problems to solve.

Where You Fit

We're looking for a product-minded software engineer who can shape what we build and how we build it. You'll be in the code every day — but we value engineers who lead naturally: through design decisions, technical direction, mentorship, and bringing the team along.

You're full-stack, but you lean heavily to one side, whether that's backend data systems or frontend product engineering. With the depth of our problems and the leverage that frontier LLMs now give us, we believe strong engineers need real depth on one side while being capable and willing to contribute across the stack.

What You'll Be Working On

Design and ship features across the agentic interface, including streaming, context window management, tool orchestration, and sandboxed execution.
Contribute to our AI layer — working with OpenAI/Anthropic models, LangChain4J, Pydantic, and our query and visualisation infrastructure.
Build and maintain integrations, custom datasets, and benchmarks that underpin our data platform.
Bring technical direction to the team — making thoughtful design decisions, reviewing code, and mentoring those around you.
Work closely with customers and product stakeholders to understand the why behind the work and translate that into elegant, impactful solutions.

What You Bring To The Role

You're a proven engineer with 5+ years of experience across different systems and domains. You've shipped impactful work and can talk honestly about the failures as well as the wins.
You break complex problems into simple, elegant solutions. You're a great communicator with strong customer empathy and a quick grasp of what the work is really trying to achieve.
You're fluent across our stack — or close to it. Languages: TypeScript, Java, Python, SQL. Data systems: PostgreSQL, DuckDB, Databricks. Platforms: AWS (Ansible + CDK), Datadog, Modal, LangFuse. UI: React, Jotai/Redux Toolkit, data viz.
You bring curiosity and humility. You mentor naturally, you're not afraid to give constructive feedback, and you genuinely enjoy learning from others' perspectives.
You build AI, and you build with AI. Comfort with AI-assisted development tooling (we use Claude Code and Codex) is a real plus here.

How You Got Here

There's no single path to this role. You might be:

originalJobContent:
The opportunity

Do you care as much about how a product feels to use as you do about the code behind it?

First Table is looking for a Front-end Engineer to build and improve the customer-facing experiences our diners use every day, from discovering somewhere new to making a booking.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working at pace, has a strong eye for UI and design, and takes pride in turning an idea or design into a polished experience for customers. You’ll work across our React and Next.js web platform, with the opportunity to contribute to our React Native mobile app as well.

You don’t need to arrive with experience across every part of our stack. We’re particularly interested in strong front-end engineers who bring great React fundamentals, customer and design thinking, and the ability to learn and adapt quickly.

We’re open to an experienced intermediate or Senior Front-end Engineer. For us, it’s less about title and more about your capability, ownership and the quality of what you ship.

About Us

At First Table, our vision is simple: to be the first place diners go to book a table.

Proudly established in Queenstown, New Zealand - where our head office is based - we've been leading the charge in the hospitality tech industry for over a decade, with operations spanning New Zealand, Australia, and the UK.

First Table is a dining discovery platform that connects diners to restaurants through their love of food. Through our clever tech, we help restaurants get their night off to a great start and give diners a compelling reason to try somewhere new. It’s a win-win situation. From early bird offers to last table reservations, we make discovering and booking great dining experiences fast, easy, and rewarding.

At the heart of everything we do are our values: Win-Win-Win, Own It and Grow Together. These guide how we show up for each other, our restaurant partners, and our diners and they’re a big part of what makes First Table a great place to work.

Learn More About Our Story Here

www.firsttable.co.nz/our-story

About The Role

As a Front-end Engineer, you’ll build and improve customer-facing experiences across the First Table product, working closely with Product, Design, Analytics and Engineering.

Our web platform is built with React, TypeScript and Next.js, alongside our React Native / Expo mobile application. While experience across both web and mobile would be great, it’s not essential. If you’re a strong web engineer who is excited about developing your skills across React Native, we’d still love to hear from you.

You’ll be joining a team that values pace, pragmatism and customer experience. We want someone who doesn’t just ask “does it work?”, but also cares about whether it looks right, feels intuitive and creates a great experience for the diner.

What you’ll be doing

Build and improve customer-facing features across the First Table diner and booking experience.
Develop responsive, performant and accessible experiences using React, TypeScript and Next.js.
Turn designs into polished experiences with a strong eye for UI quality and usability.
Work closely with Product and Design to contribute ideas, solve problems and ship improvements quickly.
Contribute across our React Native / Expo mobile app as your experience develops.
Build reusable components and work with APIs, GraphQL and our wider application architecture.
Use analytics, experimentation and AI tools to understand performance, iterate and improve how we build and ship.

What we’re looking for

You’re a front-end engineer who enjoys building products for real customers and takes pride in the quality of what ends up on screen.

Strong commercial experience with React and TypeScript. React Native / Expo experience is a bonus, along with exposure to GraphQL, analytics or design systems
Experience with modern front-end frameworks, ideally Next.js.
Experience building customer-facing digital products and a genuine interest in user experience.
Strong front-end fundamentals across responsive design, performance and accessibility.
A good eye for UI and the ability to translate designs into polished customer experiences.
Experience working with APIs and modern application architecture.
A proactive approach - you contribute, ask questions and help move work forward rather than waiting for everything to be perfectly defined.
Strong communication and collaboration across Engineering, Product and Design.
Experience in B2C, marketplace, ecommerce or fast-paced customer-facing environments would also be valuable.

Why you'll love working with us

A high trust and flexible working environment: Hybrid from Auckland or Queenstown, you’ll be enabled to work the way that best suits you, in a high-trust, independent working environment.

Build things customers actually use: Work on highly visible experiences used by diners every day, with a clear connection between what you build and the experience our customers have.

Make an impact quickly: Join a team that values pace, pragmatism and getting great work into customers’ hands rather than getting caught up in unnecessary process.

Interesting product challenges: Work across a high-volume, two-sided marketplace with challenges spanning discovery, bookings, customer behaviour, conversion and retention.

Work with an experienced team: Partner closely with our Product, Design and Engineering teams while having the space to contribute ideas, take ownership and make things happen.

Grow across web and mobile: Build on your existing front-end strengths with the opportunity to contribute across both our web and mobile products.

AI-enabled ways of working: Be part of a team actively exploring how AI can help us build, test and learn faster, while keeping strong engineering judgement at the centre of what we ship.

Shape the future: Have a genuine influence on the experiences First Table creates as we continue to grow across multiple international markets.

Beloved consumer brand: Contribute to a product that diners and restaurants already love, making a visible difference across NZ, AU, and the UK.

Perks: Free First Table bookings, regular team recognition and social events, and the chance to work with a purpose-led, award-winning brand.

What’s next?

For more insights into our culture, the role and what we are looking for, we encourage you to check out our candidate page. https://app.birdeey.com/first-table/front-end-engineer

Submit your application with your CV and a brief cover letter telling us why First Table and this opportunity appeal to you.

We’d particularly love to hear about a customer-facing feature or product you’ve personally helped take from an idea or design through to something customers could use.

We’ll be reviewing and progressing applications as they come in, so don’t wait to apply.

title: Lead Engineer - Relocate to New Zealand
originalJobContent:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

At Halter, we know how much farmers care - for their animals and their pasture. But the tools they rely on haven’t kept up, and we’re on a mission to change that. Halter helps farmers make smarter decisions - fast. We reckon good pasture management is the key to more productive and sustainable farms. More grass. Healthier soil. Happier animals. And more time back for the people doing the work.

About The Role

We're looking for Lead Engineers who perform at the top of the craft. You'll take on the hardest problems, make the calls that matter on the gnarliest design questions, and ship work that the rest of the team learns from. Engineers around you get better because they're working alongside you. We don't mind whether your strengths sit on the frontend, backend, full stack, or on the platform side that gives every other engineer leverage. What matters is that you ship robust, thoughtful work at a level few others can match, and use AI tools well.

The kind of problems our teams solve

Halter is one system: hardware, software, and AI, running live on real farms. Our engineering teams own different slices of that system, but the problems all rhyme:

Turning thousands of collars and billions of sensor events into a single, calm decision in a farmer's hand.
Modelling the physical world (animals, pasture, terrain) accurately enough to act on in real time.
Building mobile and web experiences that hold up at 5am whilst out in a paddock in the rain.
Designing platforms and pipelines that scale with our incredible pace of growth without the seams showing.
Engineering against constrained hardware, flaky rural connectivity, and the messiness of the physical world, and shipping with pace despite it.

Every team here ships software that has to work in a paddock, not just a browser tab.

What You'll Do

Take on the hardest problems and ship the work that proves them out.
Make the architectural calls that matter, then back them up by writing the code.
Set the standard for thoughtful engineering: clean, observable, easy-to-evolve code and systems.
Support and mentor other engineers through design conversations, code reviews, and generous context sharing.
Help set the pace and quality bar for engineering at Halter.
Help evolve our testing strategies, CI/CD workflows, and infrastructure patterns.
Own the reliability and performance of your domain, especially when things get tricky. Every team owns its services end-to-end, with an on-call rotation.
Get out on farm. Deep domain knowledge matters, and you'll be expected to develop it.

You'll be great if you:

Have spent years shipping complex systems in production and have the experience (and scars) to show for it.
Stay calm under pressure, have a low ego, and can rally a team through tough or complex work.
Think like a product engineer: you care about the customer experience, not just clean code.
Know how to use AI tools well to lift team output and focus on the harder stuff.
Have grown other engineers by working alongside them, not by managing them.
Are comfortable in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where adaptability beats perfection.
Have worked in cloud environments. AWS is a bonus.
A degree in software engineering (or equivalent) is nice to have, but not essential.

Depending on where you sit on the stack, some of these will land harder than others:

Frontend / Mobile: strong UX intuition, modern frontend frameworks (React, React Native a bonus), an eye for performance and polish on real devices.

Backend: building and scaling REST APIs, distributed systems, and event-driven services. Comfort with both relational and non-relational databases. Node.js, Kotlin, Go, or systems that integrate with hardware/IoT a bonus.

Full stack: all of the above, end to end, across web, mobile, and the services that power them.

Platform: you love building tooling that makes the whole company move faster, including the AI tooling that's reshaping how engineers work. Strong AWS and Terraform at scale, with experience across CI/CD, observability, and on-call tooling.

Our Benefits

Delicious snacks and drinks are available for your daily flow.
Healthy body, healthy mind. We’re partnered with Southern Cross Health Insurance to support your well-being.
We offer 6 months of fully paid parental leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks of fully paid secondary caregiver leave and many other parental benefits that support you and your family.
Our personal growth is important. Halter offers an annual $1000 self-development budget to be used for anything that fuels personal growth.
Our time to recharge is valued, we’re offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave.
Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and an employee stock ownership plan.

Our Office First Approach

There’s a reason you visit your friends in person, live with your family and don’t do dinners over Zoom. Humans are wired for connection. We believe a world-class, in-person office culture is the best way for high-performing teams.

Being office first is a core pillar of our culture. We believe in-person connections are key to driving your own growth, learning, impact, and building genuine long-lasting relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful and aligned work. We don’t like having heaps of rules or policies, but this means having strong, trusted relationships is critical.

We’re office first, not office only. This means working from the office everyday is our default setting, but we flex when we need to. We have a high-trust culture, so everyone is trusted to do what’s best for Halter.

Our office vibe is something special, it’s hard to describe until you’re here, but people at Halter who have come from fully remote or hybrid companies say they could never go back - the high energy and spectacular people they are now surrounded by everyday makes work so enjoyable. Your growth, your learning and your impact is truly unlimited here, and a big part of that comes from being together solving problems, innovating, building context, and constantly learning from each other.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.
Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.
You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.
This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"
